games.title: Layers Roll
games.description: Layers Roll is a fun, casual game where you roll over strips of the same color as your wheel. Add more layers and achieve your highest score while dodging obstacles.
games.long_description: Layers Roll is a fun, casual game where you roll over strips of the same color as your wheel. Add more layers and achieve your highest score while dodging obstacles. Collect coins along the way! Build your color wheel Use your mouse or touch screen to swipe left and right and pick up the colored layers. You can only pick up the layers that match the color of your wheel! Avoid obstacles and make smart choices Along the way, you’ll encounter various obstacles and choices. There are colored gates that change the color of your wheel shortly before you encounter new strips, surfaces that strip away the layers, and walls that stop you dead in your tracks. Along with these obstacles, there are also choices you can make to get the most layers and coins as possible. Get bonus coins and buy characters At the end of the level, you enter the bonus zone, where you continue rolling until your layers have all been stripped away. The further you get in this area, the more coins you can collect! You can then use your coins to buy fun new characters in the shop. More Games Like This If you enjoyed playing Layers Roll, you'll love Drift Boss and the other games in our casual games collection. Check out running games for more! Tips Look ahead! Planning your movements will ensure you don’t miss a color change or obstacle. Avoid the longer grey surfaces that strip away your layers when you have the choice of a shorter surface. Sometimes there is more than one path to take - always choose the path with coins! The bigger your wheel at the end, the bigger your bonus. Release Date July 2020 (iOS) Jan 2021 (Android) August 2022 (WebGL) Developer Layers Roll was developed by Clap Clap Games. Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS

games.title: Helix Jump
games.description: Helix Jump is a casual game with simple and addictively fun mechanics. In the game, you guide a bouncing ball continuously down a series of circular platforms until you crash.
games.long_description: Helix Jump is a casual game with simple and addictively fun mechanics. In the game, you guide a bouncing ball continuously down a series of circular platforms until you crash. Fall through the cracks and avoid landing in the forbidden zones! How To Play Helix Jump The goal of Helix Jump is to guide a bouncing ball down through a series of rotating platforms without falling off the edge or hitting forbidden sections. The basic mechanics are easy to follow. The key is mastering your reflexes and looking ahead. To guide the bouncing ball, rotate the platforms to align the ball with the cracks. Do this in quick succession for a combo move and higher points. If you go through 3 levels in quick succession, you're invincible for the first bounce after. Note that Helix Jump features an endless number of levels with incremental difficulty, so you may want to pace yourself. The game has missions, visible on the left side of your screen, which give you coins when completed. Use the coins you earn via the missions and the game progression to unlock special skins for your ball: there are 27 skins available, some are common, some are rare, and the least common ones are funky! Power-ups in Helix Jump Helix Jump contains two main power-ups: Fireball mode: makes your ball invincible for the first bounce after passing through 3 or more consecutive platform gaps. When in "Fireball mode", your ball can safely touch even the forbidden color and will destroy the platform it lands on. Green Arrows: these are randomly placed on some of the platforms and can transform the ball via the "fireball mode" Helix Jump - The Original This is the official Helix Jump game developed by Voodoo. The game was initially released in 2018 on mobile devices and achieved viral success. You can now play this addictive game in your web browser for free at CrazyGames! More Games Like This If you enjoy simple casual games that test your reflexes, browse our avoid and obstacle games for more. Other games that avoid obstacles include House of Hazards and Slice Master . If you're looking for a fun casual game to play mindlessly, check out Snow Rider or Geometry Dash . These are both excellent choices from here! Release Date Helix Jump was initially released as a mobile app in February 2018. Developer Voodoo developed Helix Jump. Platforms Web browser Android iOS

games.title: Dinosaur Game
games.description: Dinosaur Game is a simple T-Rex casual game in which you avoid obstacles while running for as long as possible. It was originally built into Google Chrome in 2014 and can be played without an internet connection.
games.long_description: Dinosaur Game is a simple T-Rex casual game in which you avoid obstacles while running for as long as possible. It was originally built into Google Chrome in 2014 and can be played without an internet connection. How to Play Dinosaur Game The objective of Dinosaur Game is to avoid obstacles and survive for as long as possible. The game speeds up the more you advance, making it increasingly challenging. Gameplay controls are simple - press the spacebar to start moving and click the spacebar to jump over obstacles. This side-scrolling game is reminiscent of arcade games. Your movements are limited, and success depends on avoiding obstacles, which becomes especially difficult as speed increases. As the speed increases, the further you get, you will need to factor that into your jumps. You’ll also come across cactus, birds, and more - don’t attempt to jump over the highest-flying bird. If the object is high, you can go under it. About the Original Dino Game The original Dino Game was made by Google UX developers Sebastien Gabriel, Alan Bettes, and Edward Jung in 2014. The game is built into Google Chrome and appears as an error page when the web browser is offline. The Chrome Dinosaur game has seen widespread recognition, with the creators revealing in 2018 that it was played around 270 million times monthly. A Dinosaur Game with Many Names The game is also commonly known as T-Rex Runner, Chrome Dino, and Dino Run, among many other titles. More Games Like This Other popular running games include Duck Life . You can also browse our casual category for popular side-scrolling games with similar, simple gameplay, like Happy Wheels , a ragdoll physics game that adds a bit more challenge with intricate obstacles. Developer Dinosaur Game was made by the Google UX team in 2014. Features Endless runner game featuring a T-Rex Popular game made by Google Side-scrolling camera view 2D 8-bit graphics Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile devices)

games.title: Bloxd.io
games.description: Bloxd.io is an IO adventure game with Minecraft-style visuals where you can navigate obstacle courses, gather resources, craft tools, battle other players, and much more. With game modes ranging from parkour challenges and creative sandbox building to combat-based gameplay, there's something for every playstyle.
games.long_description: Bloxd.io is an IO adventure game with Minecraft-style visuals where you can navigate obstacle courses, gather resources, craft tools, battle other players, and much more. With game modes ranging from parkour challenges and creative sandbox building to combat-based gameplay, there's something for every playstyle. How to Play Bloxd.io The best way to start playing Bloxd.io is to gather wood, your most essential early resource and useful even in caves. Kill sheep early to collect 3 wool and craft a bed, which gives you a 15-minute speed boost to help you explore faster. Follow this progression to get established: gather wood and craft a workbench, then mine stone for a stone pickaxe. From there, find iron ore, smelt it in a furnace, and craft an iron pickaxe. You'll need at least iron to mine diamonds. Game Modes BloxdHop.io : Race to the end of the map before time runs out by hopping parkour-style across blocks of all shapes and sizes. DoodleCube : Similar to Gartic.io, players build objects based on a given theme while others vote on how well they match it. EvilTower : Climb to the top of the Evil Tower using your parkour skills. Inspired by the Tower of Hell, it's a serious test of patience and precision. Peaceful : A creative, pressure-free mode where you roam freely, collect resources, and build whatever you like. CubeWarfare : Compete against other players in a third-person shooter where building blocks are part of the strategy. Bloxd.io is regularly updated with new features and modes. Other available modes include Survival, Creative, Bedwars, Sky Wars, OneBlock, Greenville, Hide and Seek, Murder Mystery, Plots, Pirates, Survival Royale, and Worlds. Look for biomes with spiky black or carved stone formations, which are a strong indicator that diamonds are nearby. Check the tips and tops of the spike towers, not just the base. Skull-shaped structures sometimes contain chests worth looting as well. Hold off on diamond armor until you have 30 or more diamonds, as a full set costs 24. Aim for Protection III enchantments before jumping into PvP, and craft a diamond pickaxe for more efficient mining. Secure your base first before spending diamonds on gear. Tips Pickaxes in Bloxd.io have unlimited durability , so one iron pickaxe goes a long way Use homes strategically — set one at your base and another near enemy bases or resource-rich areas Avoid fighting mobs and players with unenchanted armor — you can take massive damage in a single hit Don't hoard junk items; keep your inventory clean for valuable resources Bloxd.io is regularly updated with fun new features and modes. Here is a selection of current game modes. BloxdHop.io DoodleCube EvilTower Peaceful CubeWarfare Survival Peaceful Creative Bedwars Sky Wars OneBlock Greenville Hide and Seek Murder Mystery Plots Pirates Survival Royale Worlds More Games Like This Although Bloxd.io is a unique game that provides endless entertainment, there are similar titles to check out when you're finished playing. Other IO games like this include Grow A Garden , Shell Shockers , Survev io , and more. Features Explore fun, voxelated worlds for free in your web browser. Play various game modes with different objectives. Earn gold from your achievements and spend it in the store. Join your friends in multiplayer games. Release Date February 2021 Developer Arthur made BloxdHop.io. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Shell Shockers
games.description: Shell Shockers (Shellshock.io) is a multiplayer .io FPS game featuring eggs armed with guns. You control one of these weapon-wielding eggs in one of four online game modes where the aim is to shatter your opponents with bullets and bombs.
games.long_description: Shell Shockers (Shellshock.io) is a multiplayer .io FPS game featuring eggs armed with guns. You control one of these weapon-wielding eggs in one of four online game modes where the aim is to shatter your opponents with bullets and bombs. It's the ultimate online egg shooting game! Kids love games where they shoot other players. Whatever you think about guns this seems to always be the case. We let our children play Shell Shockers before the older rating games with guns because it's a less violent way to have fun online. In fact, they enjoyed it so much that even though they are older they still go back to play this again and again. Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play Shell Shockers Jump into the game and select your character name, customize your egg, and choose one of four game modes. In this game, you must work hard to protect yourself and dish out damage to opposing eggs. Try out each game mode and see if you can conquer the Shell Shockers arena. Tips and tricks Play tactically Act quickly Collect egg ammunition Think like an egg Game modes Teams Join a team (either red or blue) and fight against the enemy eggs until your team has the most kills collectively. Free For All Every egg for themselves. If you see an egg, you shoot. Unless you want to be scrambled yourself. There is only one winner in this mode. Captula the Spatula Two teams battle for control of the spatula. The team with the spatula earns points for kills, but these can be lost if the player holding the spatula dies. King of the Coop King of the Coop was added in December 2021 with a host of cosmetic items and a new map. Two teams battle to capture a defined area known as the coop. The players on the winning team get 250 golden eggs each! Weapons There are seven main weapon types in Shell Shockers. Each weapon has its advantages and drawbacks. If you have eggcellent aim, a weapon like the Crackshot would be great. If you’re more of a spray-and-pray type, try out the Whipper. The complete weapon list for Shell Shockers is: EggK-47 - classic medium-range automatic Scrambler - high-damage shotgun Free Ranger - semi-automatic sniper rifle RPEGG - huge damage RPG Whipper - close to medium range rapid-fire rifle Crackshot - bolt-action sniper rifle TriHard - accurate medium-range burst-fire rifle Additionally, each player has an additional gun and can pick up grenades from the map. Currency The game uses Golden Eggs as currency; you can use them to upgrade the way your character appears in the game or the weapons it uses. Mind you, using the Golden Eggs in the shop won’t allow you to buy items that give you an advantage during combat. More Games Like This For more online shooting games, check out our multiplayer io games and browse the selection, which includes the highly popular Agar io . If you are looking for something totally different, consider trying Bubble Shooter or 2048 . Features Fast-paced FPS gameplay A unique theme centered around eggs Various weapons and game modes Egg customization and a shop for more items Developer Shell Shockers is developed by Blue Wizard Digital (formerly known as the Egg and Dairy Ministry of Belarus). They have also developed other games, such as Basket Bros . Release Date September 2017 Platforms Web browser. We also have the Android and iOS versions.

games.title: Slice Master
games.description: Slice Master is a casual one-person game whose goal is to slice everything in sight, well, almost everything. This one-button game is driven by precision, timing, and discernment to rack up a high score.
games.long_description: Slice Master is a casual one-person game whose goal is to slice everything in sight, well, almost everything. This one-button game is driven by precision, timing, and discernment to rack up a high score. Flying knives are generally a no-no, but in this game, they are the only way to progress to new blades and skins. Slice Master reviewed We really enjoyed the fun tactile slicing of this game. The sounds are just perfect. I liked how the kids had to work out which mathematical operator was the best to go for at the end of the level - "is x4 better than +60?" Also, because you play it with just one button, it was a game that the whole family could have a go at, even from the youngest of us. In fact, our grandparents also got involved and turned out to be pretty competitive. Review by FamilyGamingDatabase How to Play Slice Master Slice Master is a one-button game controlled by the space pad on your keyboard or the left click on your mouse. All the control lies in this one simple movement. The game has an ASMR quality, and the consistent slicing is oddly soothing to the ear. The aim is simple: slice everything in sight: fruit, shapes, walls, furniture, and more. You can slice most things, but don’t add the white wall to your target list—it’s just a holding material for your knife. You will get to shop along the way, using the coins accumulated to unlock sharper blades, swords, maces, and more: anything to help you slice even more! Tips Stay away from the pink spiked metal shapes. They are too strong for your knife and will take you straight back to the beginning of the round. Sometimes these can be found at the bottom of a pile of objects to slice, so be careful to lift your knife in time to avoid them Hit the correct numeric target at the end of each level to multiply your points by the target number and boost your score. Release Date April 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile) More Games Like This If casual games are your style, you can find a slew of them in our casual game category. Go for a classic like Bubble Shooter Classic or a head-scratching word teaser like Word Search .

games.long_description: Square Bird is a side-scrolling 2D platform game. Your bird will build a tower of square eggs to avoid danger whenever you click. It's a simple and fun game! games.long_description: Mahjongg Solitaire is an online mahjong puzzle board game that features traditional rules and modern visuals. There are no shuffles, and the game is timed, but the game's pace is relaxed. How to Play Mahjongg Solitaire Spot the patterns Mahjong is a tricky puzzle game. There are so many tiles, many of which look the same but feature slight differences. Along with the need to spot these patterns, you can’t move any pieces with both sides blocked. The left or right side needs to be accessible, at least. Finding a couple of “free” tiles is the challenge here, with a tile-free being when there are no tiles on top of it. In addition, either its left or right side needs to be open. In this version of Mahjong Solitaire, you can look at the top of your screen to understand how many pairs of tiles are “free” to be matched, plus you can match the special tiles, those with a colored background, anytime. Use hints when you’re stuck Mahjongg Solitaire features hints if you get stuck, but unlike some other mahjong games, it does not have a shuffle feature. The games are also timed, meaning there is some urgency to how many tiles you can match. When the game ends, you’ll get a score for the tiles you matched and a bonus for how far you got in the game before your time ran out. Tile groups in Mahjongg Solitaire Mahjongg Solitaire features 144 tiles divided primarily into three suits. The primary suits are: Dots - feature circles Bamboo - feature lines Characters - feature Chinese characters In Mahjongg Solitaire, you’ll also notice special tiles that can be matched even without the same image. These are highlighted in blue or green. More Games Like This Mahjong Solitaire is an excellent choice for both beginners and regular Mahjong enthusiasts. However, there are many other titles in our collection of Mahjong games . Other puzzle games you may like include board games such as 2048 and Ludo . games.long_description: Piles of Mahjong is an engaging and relaxing puzzle game that combines the classic elements of Mahjong with a match-three twist. As you progress through the levels, you’ll need to clear stacks of tiles by matching three identical ones, but be careful—strategic thinking is essential to avoid getting stuck! How to Play Piles of Mahjong Piles of Mahjong brings a fresh twist to the classic Mahjong formula with some exciting new dynamics. The game has most of the same foundational rules as a classic game of table mahjong , but instead of simply matching two tiles, your goal is to match three tiles from a pile featuring a mix of familiar patterns like circles and sticks, alongside fun new additions like bird and panda heads. To make a match, you must select tiles by clicking on them, and they’ll move to one of the seven empty spaces at the bottom of the screen. But be careful! If you fill all seven spaces without making any triple matches, it’s game over. Strategic thinking is essential to clear the pile and avoid running out of space. The game offers helpful features to assist you when you’re stuck, but they come with a price. You can reshuffle the tiles with 300 reward points or by watching an ad, flip all the tiles face up for the same cost, or even auto-match tiles in the bottom row with 100 reward points or an ad. To add to the challenge, you start with two chances to remove a tile from the bottom area. Once those chances are used up, you will need to spend 100 reward points or watch an ad to earn another set of removals. These are useful if you are close to filling up your bottom spaces or if you find some tiles to pair with no space to move them to. With its engaging twists and strategic layers, Piles of Mahjong tests your puzzle-solving skills while adding a bit of pressure to every move you make! How to Play Place your battleships The battle takes place on a grid divided into squares. Each player starts with the same fleet of ships. The ships in the fleet are different sizes. Place the battleships strategically around your side of the board in a way that will avoid enemy attacks. You can place the ships horizontally or vertically. Commence the battle You and the opposing player will take turns at guessing what squares are occupied by enemy naval units. Both players get three guesses each. If you guess a square correctly, the square you picked will show the word “hit”. Sink the enemy fleet Once you’ve guessed a square correctly, that’s one of their ships narrowed down. You can keep firing until their full ship is revealed in red, which means you’ve sunk it. The more squares you reveal, the easier it gets to find the rest of their ships. But be quick - it’s a race against your opponent! Level up and unlock new weapons Keep seeing those epic aquatic battles to the end to earn XP and level up your character. You will unlock new weapons that deal damage to a greater area as you progress. Tips Try to space your ships apart as much as possible - don’t group them all together in one place Think logically when picking squares. Begin in a fog-covered land, using ancient keys to explore hidden realms and trace the path of your lost family through different eras. Discover mysterious lands and piece together an enchanting legacy. How to Play Castle Craft Step into the wondrous world of Castle Craft, where you play as farmer Fiona, determined on her heartfelt mission to reunite with her husband after a mysterious separation. Your adventure begins in a simple garden, where you combine garden beds and plants to breathe new life into the land—this is the merge element of the game. As you cultivate your wheat fields, you will harvest crops to trade for mystical keys that dispel the fog, revealing hidden territories and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Fiona restores the land, her journey takes her toward new clues about her husband Michael’s whereabouts, such as his misplaced headphones, and she encounters friendly helpers along the way. Among them is Aiden, a kind woodsman who helps her clear obstacles like a stubborn tree stump. Together, Fiona and Aiden gather timber and merge logs to create essential tools and craft materials, unlocking treasure chests filled with valuable rewards to continue on her quest. Every decision you make shapes Fiona’s path, allowing her to rebuild and expand her world. What begins as a small garden evolves into a thriving medieval kingdom, complete with bustling marketplaces and grand castles. As you progress, the adventure deepens, introducing new lands teeming with hidden treasures, mysterious puzzles, and historical figures who assist in unraveling the mysteries of time and family. To embark on this journey, start by merging three wheat sprouts to cultivate a full wheat crop, then continue merging similar items to develop the garden further. Harvest the wheat to trade for keys that unlock new areas, dispelling the fog and revealing untapped potential. Treasure chests, once opened, offer unique items and heroes to aid Fiona in reclaiming and revitalizing the land. Each merge brings you closer to tracing your family’s footsteps through history and unraveling the secrets of the past. More Games Like This Browse our adventure category for more fun titles. games.long_description: Arkadium's Bubble Shooter is an exciting casual bubble shooter game. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them and increase your score. Let's get popping! Building up on the success of Taito’s Puzzle Bobble, which became known in the Western world as Bust a Move, Arkadium’s Bubble Shooter represents an exciting twist in this peculiar genre. This version differs from those that inspired it mainly because there are no time constraints: you can carefully plan your move using all the time in this world, because your only limit is the number of moves you avail of. How to Play Arkadium's Bubble Shooter The objective of the game is to shoot your way through the levels by matching three or more bubbles with the same color. Think carefully about where you shoot and consider what color is coming next by looking below the bubble loaded. If this secondary bubble works better, you can switch to it. Choose your moves wisely The challenge is to complete each level within the moves limit. The fewer moves it takes you to complete a level, the more moves you get for the next stage. If you use all your moves, the game ends, and you're back at level 1 to try again! Tackle each unique level Every level in Arkadium's Bubble Shooter has a unique design and layout. There are conventional bubbles, but also rocks, ice balls, bombs, and other bubble types to help or hinder your progress. These unique bubbles, combined with the moves limit, add an element of problem-solving to the game. Additional novelties brought by this version of the bubble shooting classic are obstacle bubbles: Stone Bubbles cannot be popped but can only be cleared by removing the bubbles they are attached to. Ice Bubbles are frozen ones and need to be thawed before they can be popped. Once you thaw them, their color is revealed, and you can treat them as ordinary bubbles. Arkadium’s version introduces a few power-ups you can use too: Lighting bubbles, once cleared, will get rid of the whole row they are placed onto Bomb bubbles will explode when impacted, clearing a circular area around them Rainbow bubbles are wild cards; they can match any color that touches them More Games Like This Check out the classic Bubble Shooter for another free online bubble shooting game! Geometry Dash will instead give you a buzz, as you avoid obstacles on your route while moving your shape rhythmically. Features Fun, satisfying, bubble-popping gameplay! games.title: Geometry Game
games.description: Geometry Game is a free side-scrolling platformer played in sync with musical rhythms. Groove your way over and under obstacles to keep the musical momentum alive.
games.long_description: Geometry Game is a free side-scrolling platformer played in sync with musical rhythms . Groove your way over and under obstacles to keep the musical momentum alive. If you slip up, it’s back to the beginning! Inspired by the original Geometry Dash, this is a Scratch version, bringing the classic rhythm-based gameplay to your browser. "This game became our family obsession during lockdown, but we have recently returned to play it. Combining simple controls and a high level of challenge makes for a fun experience we can all enjoy. Because the play is in time with the music, it’s also a good way to develop children’s sense of timing and musicality. Sometimes we’ve even played it once the kids are in bed, to see if we can improve our skills for the next family session." Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play Geometry Game Geometry Dash is a 2D platformer game where you are in charge of moving a shape through a bunch of obstacles, all to the beat of the music. The square actually moves by itself, and all you have to do is click to jump when necessary and use the up/down arrows to steer vehicles. The way you dodge obstacles is often in sync with the beat, so make sure your sound is on and enjoy the experience! The key to the game is timing. The levels themselves scroll automatically, and hitting spikes, walls, or other hazards results in an instant crash and restart. If you fail, it's back to the beginning. The constant die-and-retry loop will have you quickly memorizing the patterns of each level and, more importantly, the precise timing of crucial jumps. This dynamic is what makes the game addictive. Listen to the beat Geometry Game is a music game, and many jumps and movements are synced to the beat of the background music, so paying attention to the rhythm is not really an option. Practice Mode lets you place checkpoints to learn tricky sections without starting over, so it's a good place to start or go back to if you're having trouble completing levels. Watch the obstacles Levels also feature unique objects like portals, pads, and orbs. Portals can flip gravity, change speed, or switch vehicle modes. Jump pads automatically launch you, and orbs trigger special actions mid-air. These elements replace traditional power-ups, creating dynamic challenges that keep each level pretty much unpredictable. Tips & Tricks Practice Mode. Use Practice Mode to break a level into smaller sections. Place checkpoints at tricky spots and repeat until you can clear each segment consistently. This builds muscle memory and makes full runs much easier. Follow the Rhythm. The game’s music often cues obstacle timing. Pay attention to beats and sync your jumps to the song. You can try humming the beat to get the rhythm down. Geometry Game Reviews The game has received positive reviews from critics. Softpedia praised the game's style, saying, "While it can get a bit frustrating sometimes, you can always complete the stages using the practice mode and then jump into the many different user-generated levels." Geometry Game History Geometry Dash started without a clear vision, according to the developer RobTop. It could have moved in any direction. It started as a template with a cube that could crash and jump, and evolved into the smash-hit game it is today. When the game was first launched, it was called Geometry Jump and only had seven levels. Later on, it was renamed "Geometry Dash." Currently, there are four free versions of the game, one being "Geometry Dash Lite," which now includes the first 13 levels from the full version. Features Challenging levels that vary in difficulty from hard to almost impossible Simple controls make the game intuitive to learn from the start Excellent music that compels you to reach the next part of the track Fun gameplay synced to the beat! games.title: Getting Over It
games.description: Getting Over It is a challenging casual arcade climbing game that puts your patience—and skill—to the ultimate test. Armed with only a hammer, you’ll tackle a steep, obstacle-laden mountain, relying on precise physics to swing, push, and propel yourself upward.
games.long_description: Getting Over It is a challenging casual arcade climbing game that puts your patience—and skill—to the ultimate test. Armed with only a hammer, you’ll tackle a steep, obstacle-laden mountain, relying on precise physics to swing, push, and propel yourself upward. Every inch you gain will make you sweat but will be well worth it, and one small mistake can send you tumbling back to the start. How to Play Getting Over It Getting Over It is a physics-inspired game where you need to climb over a series of obstacles with careful precision in the movement of your mouse. You get over obstacles using a hammer that balances your character's weight on the head of a hammer. Precision and patience are key, as the path is filled with tricky spots that demand careful maneuvering. Keep a cool head, and if you find yourself slipping back, don’t lose hope; it’s all part of the challenge. You’ll need to try and try again, building your skills and resilience with each attempt. Effective hammer use is essential to progress. With every swing, you’ll carefully leverage yourself over obstacles, pulling yourself upward, inch by inch. The mechanics may seem simple, but mastering them takes practice. Each movement requires finesse and control, so take it slow and stay focused—one wrong move could undo all your hard work. Take your time—trying to move too quickly can easily send you hurtling back to where you started! This fan-made version of Getting Over It delivers the same intense challenge as the original but with a lighthearted twist. Instead of navigating the surreal landscape as the infamous man in a pot, you play as an adorable cat planted in a flower pot, scaling a world of vibrant blocks and oversized fruit. The playful visuals add a fun, fresh spin to the gameplay, creating a setting that’s as charming as it is challenging. But don’t let the cute exterior fool you—this game is just as punishing as the original! Every fall, every slip, every unexpected tumble reminds you that success won’t come easily. The satisfaction of conquering each section of this colorful world is hard-earned, demanding patience, skill, and maybe a bit of luck. It’s an experience that will test your determination and keep you coming back for one more attempt. More Games Like This Getting Over It is quite a unique concept for a game, and it is the obstacle- based challenges that make this casual game so much fun. games.description: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is a classic puzzle logic game where your goal is to unscrew bolts from various shapes and sort them by color into the correct containers. Each level presents a new challenge that requires patience, logic, and careful planning to succeed.
games.long_description: Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is a classic puzzle logic game where your goal is to unscrew bolts from various shapes and sort them by color into the correct containers. Each level presents a new challenge that requires patience, logic, and careful planning to succeed. Be vigilant! The number of additional holes is limited, so you'll need to think a few steps ahead before making a move. Every action counts, and rushing in without a plan could leave you stuck! Once all the bolts are sorted correctly, you’ll complete the level and move on to even trickier puzzles. Can you master every challenge and become the ultimate bolt-sorting expert? How to Play Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts Your main goal in Screw Out: Bolts and Nuts is to fill all the screw containers at the top but be careful: if the extra (unmatched) screw slots fill up completely, you’ll lose the round. At the top of the screen, you have a set of empty screw holders, each with a specific color. Below, you'll see various shapes secured by colored screws. Your task is to unscrew each shape strategically, so that when all its screws are removed, the shape falls away. The trick? Only unscrew screws that match the colors of the empty slots above. Any screw without a matching color gets tossed into your limited "extra" container space. If that space fills up, and you try to unscrew more with no room left, it’s game over. Key Rules: Always have a place to put your screws. Match screw colors to top containers whenever possible. Once a container is fully filled, it refreshes with a new color, giving you more room to play, so try to fill them quickly. Special Tools & Power-Ups: Magnet – Instantly fills one container (1,500 points) Drill – Adds one additional hole (1,200 points) Hammer – Breaks and removes an entire shape (1,800 points) Skip Level – Skip to the next level (3,000 points) This game is a true brain teaser that tests your logic, timing, and strategy. How to Play Skydom Each level you play in Skydom has an objective. This objective typically involves clearing a certain amount of a particular object or gemstone. When you do, the level is complete, and you get rewarded! Some levels also put you in competition against other players online. What's unique about Skydom is that every second level, you will have to challenge an opponent to get through and reach the next stage. So the game won't be as relaxed and "solo" as most Match 3 games, but there will be some tension and another player to benchmark against. Additionally, after completing 10 levels, you will unlock a Daily Challenge, offering even more opportunities for additional earnings. Create special gemstones for powerful effects Match 3 pieces of the same color to clear them from the board and head further toward the goal. games.title: Wood Block Journey
games.description: Wood Block Journey is a puzzle, tetris-style game fused with the essence of Sudoku. Clear rows, columns, and squares and keep trying to beat your highest score.
games.long_description: Wood Block Journey is a puzzle, tetris-style game fused with the essence of Sudoku. Clear rows, columns, and squares and keep trying to beat your highest score. Complete unique missions in Journey mode. Enjoy familiar graphics, soothing sounds, and stress-free gameplay. Solve 60+ engaging puzzles with realistic wood tiles. It's a free, no-registration gaming delight. How to Play Wood Block Journey Wood Block Journey is a Tetris-inspired puzzle game where the goal is to clear the board by forming lines using various wooden shapes made up of tiles in different configurations. To clear a row, you need to align shapes like a 4-tile row, T-shaped, L-shaped, or a single tile. When you fill a row, it disappears. Each round of Wood Block Journey starts with a target score, with the progress bar at the top of the screen that tracks how close you are to reaching that score. If you place shapes on the board in the right positions, the more likely you are to clear whole lines or entire 3x3 blocks. Once you hit the target and you pass the round, you unlock the next level on the Journey map. Your current score sits on the left side of the board, with your best score displayed just below it, so you always know how well (or not well) you’re doing. Journey mode lays out its levels on a numbered map, and you work through them in order, with completed levels marked off as you go. You have a set of hearts that act as your lives, so if you fail a round, you will lose a life and the counter at the top of the map shows how many you have left. If a round slips away from you, the game offers a Second Chance before it's over. There is a timer that counts down and if you really don’t want to lose your progress, you can watch an ad and keep your current score or tap ‘No, thanks’ and end the round to start all over again. If you want to see how you’re doing compared to other players, the leaderboards button on the Journey screen pulls up a ranked list of scores. You can find your position at the bottom. It's a nice extra push to keep clearing lines and climbing. content_guide.summary: Wood Block Journey is a puzzle, tetris-style game fused with the essence of Sudoku. Clear rows, columns, and squares and keep trying to beat your highest score.
content_guide.how_to: Wood Block Journey is a Tetris-inspired puzzle game where the goal is to clear the board by forming lines using various wooden shapes made up of tiles in different configurations. To clear a row, you need to align shapes like a 4-tile row, T-shaped, L-shaped, or a single tile. When you fill a row, it disappears. Each round of Wood Block Journey starts with a target score, with the progress bar at the top of the screen that tracks how close you are to reaching that score. If you place shapes on the board in the right positions, the more likely you are to clear whole lines or entire 3x3 blocks. Once you hit the target and you pass the round, you unlock the next level on the Journey map. Your current score sits on the left side of the board, with your best score displayed just below it, so you always know how well (or not well) you’re doing. Journey mode lays out its levels on a numbered map, and you work through them in order, with completed levels marked off as you go. You have a set of hearts that act as your lives, so if you fail a round, you will lose a life and the counter at the top of the map shows how many you have left. If a round slips away from you, the game offers a Second Chance before it's over. There is a timer that counts down and if you really don’t want to lose your progress, you can watch an ad and keep your current score or tap ‘No, thanks’ and end the round to start all over again. If you want to see how you’re doing compared to other players, the leaderboards button on the Journey screen pulls up a ranked list of scores. You can find your position at the bottom. It's a nice extra push to keep clearing lines and climbing.

games.description: 2048 is a single-player sliding tile puzzle game developed by Gabriele Cirulli. Merge tiles with the same power of 2 to get the total sum.
games.long_description: 2048 is a single-player sliding tile puzzle game developed by Gabriele Cirulli. Merge tiles with the same power of 2 to get the total sum. The goal is to keep merging tiles this way until you reach 2048! My kids enjoy the simple challenge of merging the numbers to clear space and stay alive. It’s great to see them figure out strategies to merge bigger and bigger numbers efficiently. They don’t realize it, but they are learning to make quick additions. There’s also a lot of geographical thinking ahead to avoid making a move that gets you stuck. Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play 2048 The game begins on a simple 4x4 grid, with two numbered tiles appearing at random spots. Each tile is either a 2 or a 4. You will need to slide these tiles around the board and merge matching numbers until you eventually create the ultimate 2048 tile. It's not easy at first, but once you discover the patterns and better understand the rules of the game, you will find a solid rhythm you can keep going back to. Moves are easy to make. All you need to do is swipe or press the arrow keys to slide the tiles in one direction or another. Note that every move you make shifts the entire board; this means that all tiles travel until they hit either the wall or another tile. If two tiles of the same number collide, they merge into a single tile with double the value. For example, a 2 and a 2 combine to form a 4, two 4s become an 8, and so on. After each move, a new tile, again a 2 or a 4, appears on the board, slowly filling up the empty spaces. Use your arrow keys to move all the tiles in the specified direction. Note that every time you move, another two are spawned into the game. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one, doubling the value. Consider your movements and avoid sliding tiles around haphazardly. Strategy is key in this game. The board keeps filling up each time you move! If the board fills all the way without you reaching 2048, it's game over. The challenge is pretty much keeping the board from filling up completely. If there are no more moves left (no empty spaces and no adjacent matches), the game is over. The further you go, the more challenging it becomes to manage the board, as high-value tiles start to crowd out smaller numbers you still need for merging. Keep your higher-value tiles tucked away in one corner, build around them, and resist the temptation of false merges. Think a few steps ahead: merging a pair might look good now, but it could also block future moves. What is 2048? 2048 is an open-source puzzle game with math elements where players slide numerical tiles around a grid to create larger numbers. The game took the world by storm in March 2014 when it was released, surprising the developer who had made it in just a weekend. Thanks to the open-source project, many variations have been created and distributed since then. The 2048 game on this page is the original, but you can find more versions below. History of 2048 When 2048 first made its way onto the game scene, it may have seemed familiar to some players. The game drew its inspiration from Threes , an iOS game released around the same time. According to a post in The Guardian, Gabriele Cirulli, the creator of 2048, openly acknowledged the similarity, stating, "Threes is the reason 2048 exists". The clones soon started pouring in, but 2048's gameplay seemed to have created a loyal following, leaving its imitators in its wake. Tips & Tricks Focus on the edge of the grid. You want the highest number in a lovely corner for easy access. Keep making the larger numbers around that corner so you can combine them when they match. If you end up with the higher numbers towards the middle, you can quickly get lost with inaccessible numbers, and eventually, you will have to start a new game. More Games Like This If you’re a fan of puzzle games and enjoy a good brain workout, you’re in luck! Try Word Wipe , where you frantically clear words before time runs out, or Word Search , where you look for words in a sea of scrambled letters. For a different twist, 10x10 will have you scratching your head as you fit pieces like a puzzled Tetris master. And if you love word games, Word Scramble will have you rearranging letters so much that you’ll start dreaming in anagrams. Dive into these brain teasers and prepare for some serious fun! Other versions of 2048 Check out our 2048 games for more versions of this web classic! You can play a unique version of 2048 online in Cubes 2048.io , or play the delicious sushi variation of the original in Sushi Drop . Developer Gabriele Cirulli created 2048. It is based on 1024 by Veewo Studio and is conceptually similar to Threes by Asher Vollmer. Release Date March 2014 Platforms This game with puzzling tiles is available in a browser and works on any device (including iOS and Android smartphones).

games.title: Little Alchemy 2
games.description: Little Alchemy 2 is an intuitive online crafting game developed by Recloak. The aim is to combine elements to create new ones.
games.long_description: Little Alchemy 2 is an intuitive online crafting game developed by Recloak. The aim is to combine elements to create new ones. Start by mixing Earth, air, fire, and water to produce new elements. Discover over 720 items and unlock the recipes to time, matter, and the Universe! How to Play Little Alchemy 2 Little Alchemy 2 is a creative merge game where you mix and match elements to discover new, unique ones. You start with air, earth, fire, and water, then drag and drop them together to see what they produce. You can easily create simple things like mud or more complex things like humans! Every time you create something new, it becomes part of your roster of items, so you can get more and more complex. Some creations are fairly simple, but others are a bit more complicated to uncover... like zombies! Gameplay is simple. All you have to do is drag the items you want to combine from the menu on the right into the middle screen. Then, drag one object onto the other to try to combine them both. Voila! You've just become an alchemist. Remember your combinations A valid combination rewards you with new items and provides the merge in your roster of elements. You can use the encyclopedia to track your progress and read about the items you've discovered. Clean your canvas Being an alchemist will start to get messy, so thankfully, there's also a "clean up" button located in the top left to clear your canvas. The search feature in the top right is also handy when you're losing track of your creations! The sky's the limit The game has no levels, time limits, or penalties, so it’s a relaxed, open-ended experience that encourages trial and error. Humorous captions accompany each new find, adding charm while rewarding curiosity and logical thinking. With over 720 elements to uncover and optional hints when stuck, the goal is simply to keep experimenting until you’ve built an entire world from scratch. Combine the elements Alchemy Combinations Recloak is constantly updating Little Alchemy 2 with new items to craft. There are currently over 720 items. Some combinations will be more evident than others, and there are often more ways than one to create a new item. Some combinations rely on logic and others require more creative, out-of-the-box thinking. Here are some basic creations so you understand how Little Alchemy 2 works: Fire + Mist = Air Earth + Air = Dust Earth + Fire = Lava Earth + Lava = Volcano Fire + Stone = Metal These are all logical combinations. However, some combos don't seem as obvious, like water + horse creating a hippo. Sometimes you have to think outside the box and mix elements you wouldn't expect to create something. Easter Eggs The game hides fun cultural references. Dog + Internet = Doge Ring + Volcano = The One Ring Turtle + Ninja = Ninja Turtle Cat + Music = Keyboard Cat Little Alchemy Tips Click the 'hints' button in-game to get Little Alchemy tips Check out the Fandom page for more in-depth knowledge Combine elements creatively - some combos make more sense than others! Little Alchemy vs Little Alchemy 2 Little Alchemy was released in June 2016, and its sequel followed in August 2017. Both games share the same core concept of sandbox-style experimentation. You begin with four basic elements: earth, fire, air, and water. By combining them, you discover new ones. Although the foundation is the same, the sequel introduces enough changes to create a fresh experience. Little Alchemy 2 offers a brighter, more colorful design with subtle animations that give it a more playful atmosphere. It also expands the number of possible discoveries, with 720 elements compared to the original’s 589. The sequel also introduces special content such as the Myths and Monsters pack, which adds imaginative new items and makes experimentation even more engaging. Tips & Tricks Mix Everything with New Items. Each time you unlock a new element, try combining it with everything you already have. You're bound to find a new, unexpected element. Think in Categories. Items often combine logically across or within categories (ex., plant + tool = garden, fish + blade = sushi). Prioritize Key Elements. Some elements unlock dozens of recipes. Tier 1 elements and recipes Earth + Air = Dust Fire + Fire = Energy Soil + Soil = Land Earth + Fire = Lava Air + Water = Mist Water + Earth = Mud Air + Air = Pressure Water + Water = Puddle Fire + Wood = Smoke Water + Heat = Steam Tier 2 elements and recipes Mud + Fire = Brick Land + Big = Continent Earth + Motion = Earthquake Pressure + Lava = Eruption Steam + Earth = Geyser Pressure + Stone = Granite Charcoal + Mineral = Gunpowder Fire + Science = Heat Lava + Water = Obsidian Puddle + Puddle = Pond Earth + Pressure = Stone Lava + Earth = Volcano Motion + Air = Wind Tier 3 elements and recipes House + Fireplace = Chimney Mud + Sand = Clay Fire + Gunpowder = Explosion Pond + Water = Lake Stone + Fire = Metal Big + Hill = Mountain Continent + Continent = Planet Science + Star = Plasma Stone + Air = Sand Storm + Storm = Tornado Brick + Brick = Wall Heat + Air = Warmth There are 15 tiers of elements and combinations. To get the full list, refer to the fandom page. More Games Like This If you enjoy combining materials and mixing ingredients, check out our science and logic games for more challenging titles to occupy your intellect. You may also want to explore our casual category with classic games like Bubble Shooter , something a bit more challenging like Eggy Car , or something a bit more whimsical like Friday Night Funkin' . All great choices for the next play. Features Over 720 items to craft Unique discoveries to be made Logical and creative solutions Relaxing gameplay with chill music Developer Recloak develops Little Alchemy 2. Check out the original Little Alchemy , for more creative challenges! Available Game Platforms This game is developed in HTML5 and is available in your browser, on all your devices (including mobile devices and tablets!).

games.title: Word Scramble
games.description: Word Scramble is a classic word game where you unscramble letters to find words. Find one word after the next and see how many you can find before the timer runs out!
games.long_description: Word Scramble is a classic word game where you unscramble letters to find words. Find one word after the next and see how many you can find before the timer runs out! How to Play Word Scramble The gameplay in Word Scramble is relatively easy. All you need to do is click and drag letters from a series of tiles to rearrange them into a word. You may spot the word immediately and move the tiles to suit. Or you may need a bit more help to make sense of the tiles, in which case, you can choose to move the letters around until something "clicks" and you spot a word, or if you are really stumped, click the hint button and get the definition of the word - there isn't a better hint than that! Once you know the word, move the letters to form a valid word, and then click submit. The main caveat is the timer. You must form the word before the timer runs out; otherwise, the game will end, and you will have to start over again! The words vary from easy to difficult, and the game gets trickier over time. Use your problem-solving skills to determine as many as possible and get your highest score yet! Hints in Word Scramble Word Scramble can get a bit tricky, and there ain't no shame in using the hint - it is actually quite a useful piece of info. If you get stuck, you can request a hint that will help you by providing the meaning of the word in question. There is no limit to using hints, but it's always good to save hints as a last resort. Some examples of hints include: Hint: A device used to produce music. Word: Instrument Hint: A substance used to polish. Word: Polish Hint: Conversation or debate concerning a particular topic. Word: Discussion Hint: A place where items may be stored. Word: Store Hint: A device pulled through the ground to break it open into the furrows for planting. Word: Plough Hint: A container typically made of glass with a tapered neck is used for holding liquids. Word: Bottle Hint: (Uncountable) Water in frozen (solid) form. Word: Ice Hint: (Anatomy) The caudal appendage of an animal that is attached to its posterior near the anus. Word: Tail More Games Like This If you enjoy solving word puzzles, there are plenty more games like this in our word game or casual game category . Popular games you are sure to like include Word Wipe , Word Search , and Google Feud . games.description: Candy Riddles is a puzzle match-3 puzzle game bursting with tasty-looking, mouth-watering sweets! Prepare for a world of sugary fun as you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels.
games.long_description: Candy Riddles is a puzzle match-3 puzzle game bursting with tasty-looking, mouth-watering sweets! Prepare for a world of sugary fun as you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels. With each successful match of three or more treats, you'll clear the board and make way for even more delicious combinations. The more matches you make, the bigger your rewards, so keep matching and savor the sweet satisfaction of getting to the next level! How to Play Candy Riddles Candy Riddles Gameplay Candy Riddles is similar to Candy Crush but with its own unique style of gameplay. Match three or more candies to eliminate the row and unlock new candies that give you special abilities. Each level comes with a unique design that makes you think differently. Candy Riddles Levels As you move through the levels as a candy-matching machine, you'll unlock new items and challenges that keep the gameplay fresh. These can be collectible elements like honey or special sweets for matching longer chains of candy. For example, in level 3, matching five sweets will give you a rainbow cake! This eliminates all of the matched colors, creating a tasty avalanche of treats. There's much more to discover at each level, so give the game a try! More Games Like This Match-three puzzle games originated from popular tile-matching games like Tetris. The first match-three game was Shariki, released in 1994. Today, they have been hugely popularized by the likes of the Candy Crush Saga. Check out more popular merge and match-3 games like Little Alchemy . Explore our puzzle games for even more fun. games.title: Tropical Merge
games.description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items.
games.long_description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items. Whether completing quests or exploring the lush landscape, every match brings you closer to transforming your island into a perfect tropical haven. With hundreds of objects to discover and merge, the possibilities are endless—start building your dream island today! How to Play Tropical Merge Tropical Merge features various exotic objects that you can combine with other items in groups of 3 or more. Merging these three ingredients creates an entirely new object. That object, too, can be combined with two others to produce further upgrades. Each upgrade becomes more valuable as you continue to build your tropical paradise! Merging more than three items at a time will deliver a bigger number of items. Plan your merging moves strategically by trying to merge multiple objects at the same time to speed up your progression. Explore and expand to new areas The game is based on a family story, where Lisa Whitlock comes back to the island of her childhood and is tasked with making it a tropical heaven again. Get rid of the weeds, earn amulets and level up to unlock more areas and expand your island. Move the cards around the tableau so they are in order by suit and number. Take more cards from the pile if you get stuck. See if you can win at this tricky game! How to Play Basic Solitaire rules The rules of Solitaire are simple, but it can be a tricky game to master. The objective is to successfully remove all the cards from the playing field by placing them in number order by their respective suit. Move the visible cards around to create a complete set in order from King to Ace. The cards must be placed in the same suit, in numerical order. If you cannot move any card, you need to click the pile of cards that is face down to add a new card to each row. If you are stuck, you can always use the reset button to start from scratch! Can you master Spider Solitaire 2 Suits? Spider Solitaire rules Unlike basic Solitaire, Spider Solitaire is trickier. It features two decks of cards and 10 rows. Playing with only two suits ramps up the difficulty even further. Other than these limitations, the rules are the same as regular Solitaire. You must stack cards of the same suit in descending order on the tableau. You’ll win the game when all the cards have been put in order. About this game This simple Spider Solitaire 2 Suits game features a clean, retro interface. There are no hints, so you should be experienced at playing Spider Solitaire before jumping into this one. However, you can undo your previous moves or completely reset the game when you get stuck. More Games Like This If you are a beginner to Solitaire, you might want to try playing an easier variant of the game first. games.description: Golf Solitaire is a fun and challenging solo card game. Clear all the cards by placing them in order and returning them to the pile until none are remaining.
games.long_description: Golf Solitaire is a fun and challenging solo card game. Clear all the cards by placing them in order and returning them to the pile until none are remaining. This game uses a regular 52-card deck, but the rules differ from regular Solitaire. How to Play Golf Solitaire The objective of Golf Solitaire is to get all cards from the seven columns into the single face-up pile at the bottom. Cards can be moved to this pile if they are one number higher or lower than the top card. When there are no cards to play, you can flip a card from the face-down pile until you get one that can be played. How do I win? You win the game when you successfully move all the cards from the seven columns into your face-up pile. The game is lost when you get stuck with no more cards left to play. However, there are hints and a "card steal" button for when you're stuck. Steal takes a card from one of the columns at random, regardless of what it is. The hint button will show you the best move when there are moves available. More Solitaire Games Solo card games are a popular way to pass the time and stimulate the mind when at home. games.title: Sandtrix
games.description: Sandtrix is a Tetris game with a twist—the pieces transform into sand when they touch down. The objective is to align blocks of the same color until they form one continuous color from left to right.
games.long_description: Sandtrix is a Tetris game with a twist—the pieces transform into sand when they touch down. The objective is to align blocks of the same color until they form one continuous color from left to right. When you make a horizontal line of color, the pixels disappear, and you earn points. How to Play Game modes There are three game modes to enjoy in Sandtrix. The first is the classic endless mode . In this mode, you clear sand endlessly until the inevitable filling of the game area. As time progresses, the speed increases. Once the blocks reach the top, it’s game over. The other game modes follow similar rules but have fundamental differences. In the high-score game mode , the objective is to get the highest possible score within 3 minutes. Other than that, the rules are the same. In clear 40 it is precisely as the name suggests—clear 40 rows. There is no time limit in this mode. Just make sure you don’t fail! You get one point for a pixel cleared in any game mode. If you clear a row again before the meter runs out, you can reach combos up to 10x. Difficulty There are three difficulty levels in Sandtrix. In easy mode, you have the whole game space to place your blocks, and the speed is normal. However, the medium and hard difficulties ramp up the speed and limit the available play space. Hard mode is particularly challenging. We strongly recommend staying on the first difficulty setting for a while before attempting the others. About Sandtrix Sandtrix is also known as Sandtris, Setris, and Sand Tetris, among other names. In part, it’s due to the game going viral under various names on TikTok and other social platforms. It might seem to defeat the purpose of Tetris for the pieces to turn into sand, but the more you play, the more you realize the smaller details about how each shapes land, and learn to maximize each piece more effectively. More Games Like This If you enjoy playing novel and exciting puzzles, check out our complete collection of puzzle games . There are also plenty of Tetris-themed games to check out. games.title: Yahtzee Online
games.description: Test your dice skills with Yahtzee Online. Play a fun online Yahtzee game against up to 3 opponents.
games.long_description: Test your dice skills with Yahtzee Online. Play a fun online Yahtzee game against up to 3 opponents. This classic Yahtzee game brings you all the fun of this traditional dice game in your web browser. It has a perfect blend of tactics, strategy, and luck to keep you entertained. How to Play Yahtzee Start playing either a single-player game or against up to 3 opponents. If you play multiplayer, the players have to be on the same computer and take turns to play. The four-player action is fantastic - if you don't own the dice game, you can have fun with your friends and family on this online version. The graphics also look brilliant with smooth dice animations, and a scoreboard that is easy to understand. There is also some classy music to listen to whilst you play! Basic Yahtzee tips The premise of Yahtzee is simple - you roll 5 dice and must try to create different combinations like a full house, large straight, or three of a kind. For each dice roll, select one of the scoring categories - this is why strategy is important. Rolling the dice is pure luck, but selecting your hand requires skill. As with the standard game, if you score a Yahtzee (5 of the same number), you score 50 points. Remember that if your left-hand column scores are greater than 65, you gain a bonus of 35 points too. Use this to your advantage and try to create the best combinations. Different combinations of Yahtzee Yahtzee Online has a variety of different scoring combinations. The left-hand side contains number scores - you must count how many dice you have of one number, and add them together to get your score. For example, rolling 4x fours would be a score of 16. The right-hand side contains the specialist scores, including: Three of a kind Four of a kind Little straight (four numbers in a row i.e. 1,2, 3, 4) Big straight (five numbers in a row i.e. 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) Full House (two of one number, three of another number) Chance (score of your five random dice added together) Be sure to understand the different combinations and the way they are calculated. Once you understand this you can put strategies into practice and play this amazing Yathzee game with skill! Release Date February 2018 Developer Yahtzee Online was made by Code This Lab. games.title: Bolts and Nuts
games.description: Bolts and Nuts is a simple and fun puzzle game in which you test your logic and strategic thinking by solving unique puzzles, all with a ticking timer breathing down your neck.How to Play Bolts and NutsThe game is a classic puzzle game where you aim to strategically remove bolts so that the panels they are holding up all fall off the game screen.
games.long_description: Bolts and Nuts is a simple and fun puzzle game in which you test your logic and strategic thinking by solving unique puzzles, all with a ticking timer breathing down your neck. How to Play Bolts and Nuts The game is a classic puzzle game where you aim to strategically remove bolts so that the panels they are holding up all fall off the game screen. Once you remove a bolt, you need to add it to a free hole. The only obstacle is that there is a limited number of free holes, and some inadvertently get covered by the panels you freed up. This means you need to think a few steps ahead before acting fast. As you advance in levels, the task becomes more complicated, and you need to discern how best to beat the clock. There are over a hundred levels in the game, which become increasingly more complex. No need to worry; the levels may get more complex over time, but you also accumulate more points, which you can use to buy help, such as screwdrivers to remove bolts for which there is no room, or time freezers. This is one of those games where finishing a level brings satisfaction, but then you quickly want to move on to the next round and test your skill once again. It is an addictive game of logic, risk, and quick thinking. Bolts and Nuts is a feel-good game suitable for children, but it also provides adults with the opportunity to challenge their problem-solving skills. Beat the clock Each level has a countdown timer, and when it runs down, you will lose the progress made on that level, but you will be able to start the level over, so use what you’ve learned and don’t get trapped in the same time constraints. A stopwatch is located at the bottom of the screen, allowing you to pause time. This will be useful when you have a few strategic moves left but not enough time to finish the level. Tips You can unlock bolt holes by clicking on one of the advertisement bolts. You’ll have to watch a quick ad to get a free hole. It’s worth it if you are in a jam. Another alternative is the bonus screwdriver at the bottom of the screen. The more points you gain, the more bonus bolt removals you will get. Use them sparingly because you’ll need them further down the line. Re-fill some holes with bolts. Moving bolts around to different empty holes is part of the strategy. Find which bolts can be removed that won’t cover any open holes. When you lift a bolt and decide where to place it, panels may shift, so don’t hesitate too long. content_guide.how_to: The game is a classic puzzle game where you aim to strategically remove bolts so that the panels they are holding up all fall off the game screen. games.title: Cut the Rope
games.description: Cut the Rope to feed large pieces of candy to a hungry creature called Om Nom. Collect all the stars for the highest rating and progress to more challenging levels with new puzzles.
games.long_description: Cut the Rope to feed large pieces of candy to a hungry creature called Om Nom. Collect all the stars for the highest rating and progress to more challenging levels with new puzzles. This is the first game in the Cut the Rope franchise, a series of physics-based puzzle games where you must cut ropes, collect stars, and feed your hungry monster friend. How to Play Cut the Rope After you pass the tutorial, the game begins with the monster Om Nom inside a box, which gets opened in front of you. Inside the box, there are candies and stars. You'll have to cut the ropes holding the candies in the correct order so the candies swing and collect all the stars, then feed Om Nom. Sometimes, you must slice through the rope at the right moment so it falls in the right direction. You need a certain number of stars to continue progress in Cut the Rope. As you get further, you’ll encounter new puzzle elements like bubbles and air cushions. Use these devices to secure all the stars before feeding little Om Nom. "Seasons" and boxes in Cut the Rope There are 3 "seasons" in Cut the Rope. Each season features different types of boxes in which Om Nom is contained and where the magic needs to happen. For each box, there are 25 different puzzles for a total of 75 stars to collect, and each one introduces a new feature to the puzzles. The types of boxes available are: Season 1 Cardboard Box Fabric Box Foil Box Magic Box Valentine's Box Season 2 Toy Box Gift Box Cosmic Box Tool Box Buzz Box Season 3 DJ Box Spooky Box Steam Box Lantern Box Cheese Box Pillow Box Mechanical Cut the Rope is different from similar games because you do not necessarily need to start from the 1st type of box in the first season, but can kick off playing in any of the available seasons. So if you are stuck on some hard-to-beat level, you can start playing a different puzzle and then get back to it at a later stage. Features Fun, physics-based puzzles Extra stars for bonus points Features the playful creature Om Nom Release Date March 2012 (Android) September 2015 (iOS) May 2024 (HTML5) Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS Developer Cut the Rope was made by Famobi and ZeptoLab. Why not give them all a try and see what fun you can have cutting the rope? games.long_description: Nonogram is a captivating logic game where you fill in spaces on a numerical grid to reveal an image. Think carefully to avoid hitting a cross, and fill in the correct squares to complete the picture. How to Play Nonogram Assess the grid Start by assessing the grid. Look at the numbers across the top and down the side. These numbers tell you how many squares to fill in on the corresponding row or column. However, these numbers don’t tell you exactly which squares should or shouldn’t be filled in, and are just a clue. Process of elimination Use a process of elimination between the rows and columns to find the correct squares to fill in and avoid. For example, if you have cleared all the required squares in one column, it follows that no more squares should be filled in that column, so you can avoid it when filling in the rows, and vice versa. Reveal a picture When you complete the grid without error, you’ll reveal an image and successfully finish the level. The game will then load a new Nonogram puzzle for you to play. If you get stuck, there are 3 hints available on each puzzle. More logic puzzles Nonogram is a fun and simple puzzle game to play. Once you’ve finished, check out some more puzzles or coloring games . You might enjoy a more challenging puzzle game like Bloxorz. games.long_description: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques. Whether you’re aiming to outwit a friend or conquer global rivals, every shot counts in your quest to become the ultimate billiards champion. How to Play 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer 8 Ball Pool Billiards is just like your classic pool game, where your objective is to pot your balls into the pockets. This game adds a fun twist in that you can play with random players from all around the world, helping you enhance your game to a pro-level with continued practice. The game begins with a break shot where you hit the cue ball to scatter the other balls. Your objective is to pot the balls into pockets using the cue ball where possible. The first break will tell you whether you are stripes or solids, depending on what ball you get in the pocket first. In each turn, aim to strike the cue ball to hit your target ball into a pocket. If successful, you continue your turn; otherwise, your opponent takes their turn. The key is to use strategic shots to position the cue ball for the next play and try to control the table by positioning balls to your advantage. The direction of where your ball will land is outlined from the stick to the ball with an arrow, giving you an indication of the target path. The player who pots all their balls first wins the game. Choose from numerous game rooms, such as a private two-player game between you and your friend, a quick play game where you choose your level and play against the public quickly, or a local play where you may need to wait a bit to be matched with a live partner. games.description: 8-Ball Billiards is a free online pool game in our sports category, ideal for one or two players. You can play solo against AI or challenge other players in two-player mode.
games.long_description: 8-Ball Billiards is a free online pool game in our sports category, ideal for one or two players. You can play solo against AI or challenge other players in two-player mode. The game is easy for anyone to play, so pick up a cue and line up your first shot. How to Play 8 Ball Billiards Classic 8 Ball Billiards Classic is much like the classic in-person game: your goal is to pocket all your balls (either solids or stripes) and sink the 8-ball to win. Use your mouse to aim the cue stick and adjust the power of your shot. Click and drag the cue stick back to set your shot’s power, then release it to strike the cue ball. This is a 2-player game, so carefully plan each shot to outmaneuver your opponent and clear the table before they do! You can use the settings to choose the ability of your AI-controlled opponents and, if you are good at it, you can also remove the visual help that allows you to understand the trajectory of your shots. Pick a ball 8-Ball Billiards is an intuitive billiards game where you must pot all the striped or spotted balls, depending on the color assigned to you. The balls you’re assigned depend on what ball is potted first, so shoot for the win! Line up your cue The controls are easy. Simply click and drag to find the right level of force, then line up the angle with the ball that seems easiest to pot next. Remember that this is pool, so save the 8-ball until you have potted all your balls, otherwise, you will lose! games.title: Mini Golf Club
games.description: Mini Golf Club is a multiplayer mini-golf game where you compete against real players across short, themed courses. Your objective is to sink the ball in as few strokes as possible before the timer runs out.
games.long_description: Mini Golf Club is a multiplayer mini-golf game where you compete against real players across short, themed courses. Your objective is to sink the ball in as few strokes as possible before the timer runs out. Winning matches earns you coins, which you can spend on hats, trails, and colors for your ball. How to Play Mini Golf Club You have a few choices to make when you start the game: Play Online: Jump into a multiplayer match against real players. Daily Hole: A special hole that resets every day, with a countdown timer showing when the next one arrives. Career: Work your way through 612 holes of solo play. Create: Build your own hole. Join: Enter a match or course someone else has set up. Best: Browse top-rated community creations. You'll also find the Shop and Settings buttons in the bottom corner, plus a Discord link if you want to find the community. Playing a Match Hit Play Online and the game drops you onto the green, with the controls shown right on screen for your first hole. You can play with the keyboard, mouse, touch controls, or a controller. Keyboard: Hold the Spacebar and use the Arrow keys or WASD to aim. The longer you hold, the more power builds. Release to shoot. Mouse: Hold the Left Mouse button and move the mouse to aim. Release to shoot. A power bar at the bottom of the screen shows your shot strength as a percentage. At low power, the ring around your ball glows yellow. At full power, the ring turns red, and a long red line extends from the ball showing your shot direction. A few things to watch on screen: The hole counter in the top right shows your progress through the match (for example, 1/3 Cyber Core or 2/3 Frozen Flyer). Matches run through a short series of themed holes. The timer in the top left counts down from 60 seconds, so don't overthink your shot. The distance marker floats over the flag and tells you how far away the hole is (24m, 33m, and so on). Par is displayed on the left, so you know the target stroke count for the hole. Your opponent's name and score appear at the top of the screen, so you can keep track of your competition. Most courses are surrounded by water, and overshooting the green means a lost stroke. Water isn't the only hazard, either. Courses throw ramps, tunnels, slopes, moving obstacles, sand traps, and even portals at you, plus boosters like wind zones and jump pads that push your ball around. Take the angles, walls, and obstacles into account before you fire. Playing with Friends You don't need an internet lobby to compete. Versus mode runs turn-based matches for up to 4 players on the same device, passing between turns, while Splitscreen divides the screen so up to 4 players can play at once. Both are easy ways to turn this into a couch game with friends and family. Customizing Your Ball Hit Customize on the main menu to choose colors, trails, and more: Hats: Dress your ball up in a baseball cap, bowler, sun hat, wizard hat, and more. The red baseball cap is free, and the rest cost 250 to 500 coins. Trails: Choose the effect your ball leaves behind as it rolls. Trail styles cost 500 coins each. Colors: Fine-tune the look with a full color picker. You can set separate colors for the ball itself, the start of the trail, and the end of the trail. The Shop Coins are the game's currency, and you earn them by playing, watching short videos, or buying them directly. The Shop offers coin packs ranging from 1,500 coins for 1.99 USD up to 60,000 coins for 49.99 USD, with the 12,000 coin pack marked as the most popular option.
