games.description: 2 Minute Football QB Legend is a fast-paced sports football game where you take control as the star quarterback. Lead your team through the season and playoffs, making strategic plays to claim the championship title.
games.long_description: 2 Minute Football QB Legend is a fast-paced sports football game where you take control as the star quarterback. Lead your team through the season and playoffs, making strategic plays to claim the championship title. With full games and opponent simulation, every match challenges your skills and decision-making on the field. How to Play 2 Minute Football QB Legend It's football time and the game is on with 2 Minute Football QB Legend. Step onto the field and take control as the quarterback in this fast-paced football showdown! Your job is to pass the ball to a receiver running along the yellow lines. Once they catch it, keep running until you're tackled: the next play starts from that spot. Use the keys or mouse to steer, and don’t forget you can spin once per play (press space or double-click) to dodge defenders. A down is a single play, and you have four plays to gain 20 yards; fail, and your opponent takes possession. Score a touchdown by catching or running the ball into the end zone for 7 points. Each game consists of four one-minute quarters, and you need to be leading when the clock runs out to claim victory. Want to stop the clock? Run out of bounds to buy yourself extra time, especially when every second counts. That’s it, rookie, you're ready for action! The stadium is roaring, the helmets are lined up, and the pressure is on. Can you lead your team to glory? games.title: Table Tennis World Tour
games.description: Table Tennis World Tour is a thrilling sports game where you compete in table tennis matches against various opponents.Choose your country and step into the global arena, where you'll face off against a diverse array of opponents from around the world.
games.long_description: Table Tennis World Tour is a thrilling sports game where you compete in table tennis matches against various opponents. Choose your country and step into the global arena, where you'll face off against a diverse array of opponents from around the world. Each match is a high-stakes showdown as you compete to rise through the ranks and become the ultimate table tennis champion. How to Play Table Tennis World Tour Swing and serve You only need to drag your mouse to move the racket toward the ball. The way you swing the racket affects the ball’s direction. You can move the racket closer or further away to achieve a more controlled strike. Try to catch your opponent off guard with a good angled hit to build up the points. Score the most points The match is over when the first team reaches a score of 11. Keep the pressure on your opponent to get there before they do! Each tournament you play has six games against other players worldwide. You can move on to the next level when you obtain the trophy for the first country. Stay focused Your AI opponents in the Table Tennis World Tour are dynamic and vary in difficulty depending on the stage you’re at. This changing difficulty level means you must think on your toes to beat your next opponent. The key to hitting the ball is all about what position you’re in. If you move your racket close to the ball as it comes towards you, you are more likely to get a good shot. Once your racket is in the ball’s direction, it will make contact automatically, so there's no separate swing button to press. The angle you hold your racket at the moment of contact decides where the ball lands on your opponent's side, so tilting into your shot lets you place the ball in a corner or push it wide where your opponent can't reach. Just be careful not to overdo it, because if you are too aggressive, the angle can send the ball flying off the table and hand your opponent a free point. Choose Your Team Before your tour begins, you can pick your country from a selection of 40 flags with options ranging from Brazil and Japan to Kazakhstan and Uruguay. From there, the world map lays out your journey through numbered tournament stops, each hosted in a different region of the globe. You work through them in order, and a trophy marks the stop you're currently competing in. Each tournament stop is a series of six matches, and a counter in the top corner tracks how far along you are. Every match pits your country against a new opponent, with the flags and score displayed on the board above the table. To unlock the next destination on the map, you need to win all six matches and claim that country’s trophy. More Games Like This If you enjoy playing sports games then there is a wide selection to choose from, including Basketball Stars , 8 Ball Pool , Soccer Bros , Wrestle Bros and more. Check out Little Alchemy or Little Alchemy 2 to try something new! Developer Happylander developed Table Tennis World Tour. Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.description: Baseball is a sports game that lets you experience being part of the great American pastime as a batter, all in the comfort of your browser! There are 2 modes available to play, and both of them are just as fun as the other.
games.long_description: Baseball is a sports game that lets you experience being part of the great American pastime as a batter, all in the comfort of your browser! There are 2 modes available to play, and both of them are just as fun as the other. Bottom of the Ninth gives you the chance to win a walk-off win. Your team is batting, and you're down by 4 points. You need to score 5 runs with only 3 outs available to win the game. Arcade mode gives you a simple objective. games.title: Ragdoll Soccer 2 Players
games.description: Ragdoll Soccer: 2 Players is a sports soccer game that delivers the ultimate blend of soccer and chaos, where wobbly ragdoll physics takes over the field for hilarious and unpredictable gameplay! Step into the shoes (or, more accurately, the floppy limbs) of a stickman player and take on the challenge solo or face off against a friend in intense local multiplayer.
games.long_description: Ragdoll Soccer: 2 Players is a sports soccer game that delivers the ultimate blend of soccer and chaos, where wobbly ragdoll physics takes over the field for hilarious and unpredictable gameplay! Step into the shoes (or, more accurately, the floppy limbs) of a stickman player and take on the challenge solo or face off against a friend in intense local multiplayer. With a variety of modes like Championship, Penalty Shootout, and single-player, there's never a dull moment. How to Play Ragdoll Soccer 2 Players In Ragdoll Soccer, the game kicks off with a tutorial, so pay close attention because the wobbly physics can be tricky! Use the classic WASD keys to move your ragdoll player, and press Q for a headbutt and E for a kick. Mastering these controls is essential, but be prepared for some chaotic and hilarious moments, as your stickman will often flop and flail unpredictably. Boosters add an extra layer of fun and strategy. Use the Small Ball for more control, Freeze to freeze opponents in their tracks, Gates to block or trap your rival, and Goalkeeper to defend your goal. Choose from several game modes, including Training, Classic Match, or challenge a friend in 2-player mode with either a classic match or penalty shootout. If you’re feeling adventurous, try the Field or Matrix modes, where the pitch is a bit more... abyss-like! The ragdoll mechanics are what make this game truly unique – your player moves like an inflatable tube man, so you never know which direction your limbs will flail next! Earn upgrade points by completing challenges or watch an ad to unlock new Stickman skins. The unpredictability is part of the fun, and it’s all about embracing the chaos while trying to score those hilarious goals. Master the art of scoring spectacular goals, utilizing unique boosters and abilities to outsmart your opponent, and enjoy the unpredictable hilarity that comes with every kick. Unlock a range of skins and new arenas, ensuring each match feels fresh and exciting. Whether you're scoring goals in dramatic fashion or laughing at your own wobbly mishaps, Ragdoll Soccer delivers non-stop fun, epic moments, and a dose of competitive action you won’t want to miss. More Games Like This Stay in the game and explore some of our most exciting sports titles , including popular soccer games like Soccer Random , a two-player wacky soccer game where timing is everything and control is chaos; A Small World Cup , a fun mini-soccer sports game where you control a rag doll and slam it against the arena to make the ball score a goal. games.title: Basketball Superstars
games.description: Basketball Superstars is a dynamic basketball experience where you create and train your ultimate player. Customize your gear, enhance your skills, and face intense rivals in fast-paced matches.
games.long_description: Basketball Superstars is a dynamic basketball experience where you create and train your ultimate player. Customize your gear, enhance your skills, and face intense rivals in fast-paced matches. Whether you are outsmarting opponents or perfecting your strategy, each game delivers action and excitement as you strive to dominate the court and showcase your prowess. How to Play Basketball Superstars Basketball Stars is a fast-paced, arcade-style basketball game where you compete in one-on-one matches. Use the Arrow Keys to move around the court and dribble past your opponent. Press and hold the Spacebar to shoot, releasing it at the right moment for a perfect shot. If you're close to the hoop, pressing Spacebar will let you perform a slam dunk. On defense, you can steal the ball by getting close to your opponent and tapping Spacebar when they’re dribbling. Time your jumps carefully to block incoming shots. Aggressive play is key in Basketball Stars! When your opponent is on offense, stay close and look for the perfect moment to steal the ball. Time your movements carefully: when they’re dribbling, tap Spacebar to snatch it away. If they go for a shot, jump at the right moment to block it. Once you have possession, don’t hesitate, drive toward the hoop, and take your shot. Whether you’re aiming for a long-range jumper or a slam dunk, act fast and keep the pressure on. Quick decisions and relentless attacks will keep your opponent on their toes and give you the edge in every match! As you play, you’ll earn coins scattered around the court and receive rewards for winning matches. You can claim free daily stars and upgrade your coins, stars, and tickets to enhance your gameplay. Special packs are available for purchase, offering different combinations of tickets, stars, and coins. Packs include: Super Pack 1: 1 ticket, 3 stars, 2,000 coins Super Pack 2 (Most Popular): 1 ticket, 8 stars, 7,500 coins Super Pack 3 (Biggest Boost): 1 ticket, 20 stars, 15,000 coins Customization is a key part of the experience, allowing you to change your basketball outfit and modify your character’s appearance. Your performance is graded based on defense, shooting, speed, and dunking, so strategize your playstyle to dominate the court! How to Play Basketball Orbit Your goal in Basketball Orbit is to sink a basketball into the hoop from over 100 feet away. Don’t worry, you don’t have to make the shot in one go. Your score is based on strength, speed, and bounce, and those attributes determine your rewards. This one-click game demands both patience and precision. Watch the color meter in the center of your screen as it flashes red, yellow, orange, and green. Click when the meter hits green for the best shot. A green click sends your ball soaring. Yellow gets you partway, and red? That just keeps the ball bouncing at your feet. Keep clicking to move forward. Once you're within a few feet of the hoop, you can fine-tune your shot: click and move your mouse to aim directly into the basket. games.title: Madness Cars Destroy
games.description: Madness Cars Destroy is a high-octane car driving game packed with six thrilling modes. Push rivals off narrowing paths in Funnel, survive the spinning Rotating Cube, or dodge bombs in Deadly Arena.
games.long_description: Madness Cars Destroy is a high-octane car driving game packed with six thrilling modes. Push rivals off narrowing paths in Funnel, survive the spinning Rotating Cube, or dodge bombs in Deadly Arena. Outsmart opponents in Right Color, evade traps in Deadly Bouncers, and pass the explosive Hot Potato. Choose your ride and jump into intense, fast-paced action! How to Play Madness Cars Destroy Strap in for a wild ride in Madness Cars Destroy, where every race is a test of skill, strategy, and survival! Your car is placed on a Rubik’s Cube-like platform, suspended over an abyss: one wrong move, and you’re sent plummeting into the void. Your challenges range from navigating checkpoints to knocking rival cars off the edge. As you progress, new landscapes unlock, including a spinning top, a full Rubik’s Cube, a collapsing floor, and more. Customize your car with spoilers, wheels, paint, tint, and suspension upgrades, but you’ll need to earn points before you can trick out your ride. Some rounds challenge you to touch as many cars as possible by ramming into them before massive spiked balls knock you off the arena. If you get thrown off, you’ll face a brutal penalty: no car collisions for a full five minutes! In another high-stakes mode, you’ll choose between fleeing or attacking. Opt to shoot, and you’ll rain bombs from above, sabotaging the arena floor to send enemy cars tumbling into oblivion. Choose to flee, and you’ll be the one racing for your life! Other challenges include chaotic bomb-passing rounds, where you must avoid detonation on a board packed with frantic cars. With relentless action and ever-changing obstacles, Madness Cars Destroy keeps you constantly on edge, testing your reflexes and strategy in every round More Games Like This Don't want to finish your ride? games.description: Mr Racer - Car Racing is a fast-paced driving game where you speed through traffic-packed streets in sleek supercars, taking on challenges to prove you're the ultimate racer.How to Play Mr RacerStart your racing journey with speed into the action!
games.long_description: Mr Racer - Car Racing is a fast-paced driving game where you speed through traffic-packed streets in sleek supercars, taking on challenges to prove you're the ultimate racer. How to Play Mr Racer Start your racing journey with speed into the action! In Mr. Racer, there are various game modes that offer an exciting driving experience in a range of flashy automobiles. Speed your way through 5 unique locations, progressing your career as a racing driver and earning EXP to level up. Game Modes Challenge Mode : it contains 100 different missions, keeping the game fresh and offering new and tricky tasks. Most of the challenges are time-based. You earn back some time by overtaking other vehicles quickly. Career Race Mode : you’ll compete against an AI racer to place first. There are no bonuses for fast overtakes, so focus on beating your opponent to complete the mission successfully. The ultimate reward in this mode is to “Become a Legend”. Endless Mode: no limits here, drive as much as you can to obtain the highest score. Free Ride : it can be used for practice and to improve your driving skills. Chase Mode : chase the opposition down and show them who the master racer is! This mode features unlimited racing and focuses on your pursuit of opposing cars. It is locked at first, and it’s unlocked by 99.000 cash. Time Trial : no opponents here, challenge yourself to score the best time. This game mode is also locked when you first start playing, and you can play it by unlocking it with 49.000 cash. Buy and upgrade new vehicles As you progress through the game and explore the various game modes on offer, you’ll earn money to buy new vehicles. There are various cars, some of which are incredibly fast. These newer vehicles will help you beat your opponents in races more easily. You can also upgrade your vehicles with new paint jobs, wheels, lights, and wheel stances. Tips Close overtakes within a two-second window give score bonuses and, in some game modes, a time advantage. Be careful not to get too close to the other cars because, unlike other driving games, in this one, it’s game over as soon as you touch another vehicle. games.long_description: Offroad Island is the ultimate driving truck simulation game that puts you behind the wheel of powerful trucks, rugged trailers, agile quads, high-speed bikes, and much more. Get ready to explore three vast, open-world environments, each filled with challenging terrains, hidden paths, and stunning landscapes. Perform daring stunts, collect valuable coins, and tackle tough trials to earn major rewards as you push your skills to the limit. With every twist, turn, and jump, the adventure gets more intense. Buckle up! How to Play Offroad Island Your goal in Offroad Island is to explore the map, gather gold, and complete races. There are three expansive, open-world maps, each offering its own set of challenges and terrains. From the stunt-filled Woodlands to the muddy, dense forests of MuddyHill, every map is uniquely designed to push your off-road skills to the limit. Whether navigating rugged trails, conquering steep hills, or mastering tight corners, these environments will keep you on your toes. The game boasts a stunning collection of vehicles, ranging from iconic Cherokees and rugged Hummers to classic hotrods. But that’s just the beginning! You can also purchase quads, SxS vehicles, crawlers, bikes, and even hook-up trailers for your ride. Explore the premium vehicle collection for a selection of custom motors to make your off-road adventure even more thrilling. Once you’ve chosen your vehicle, the true fun begins with a wide range of customization options. Personalize every detail—from the body and paint job to rims and tires. To enhance performance, tweak everything from engine power to weight distribution, suspension, and gearbox settings. The in-depth tuning menu lets you fine-tune each component to create the perfect off-road machine suited to your driving style. The graphics in Offroad Island are quite realistic, where every terrain comes to life. As you drive, your vehicle’s wheels tear into the dirt, splashing mud and leaving behind a trail of debris that coats your ride. The suspension reacts dynamically to the ever-changing ground beneath you, providing a truly immersive experience. Whether you're conquering rocky hills or drifting through muddy swamps, the varied terrain ensures every ride feels authentic and challenging. games.description: Parking Jam is a challenging puzzle game where you untangle a crowded parking lot one car at a time. Use your logic and problem-solving skills to move vehicles in the correct order, clearing the way without causing chaos.
games.long_description: Parking Jam is a challenging puzzle game where you untangle a crowded parking lot one car at a time. Use your logic and problem-solving skills to move vehicles in the correct order, clearing the way without causing chaos. With each level, tackle increasingly complex puzzles filled with more cars and tricky obstacles. How to Play Parking Jam Everyone's been stuck in a parking jam, but the real challenge is figuring out how to escape! This is a satisfying puzzle game where you click and drag cars to clear them from a crowded parking lot and onto the street. As you progress through the rounds, the difficulty increases, with road barriers and tighter spaces making it harder to maneuver the vehicles. Careful planning is key to getting all the cars out. Cars can be moved in reverse, allowing for different strategies to clear the jam. Each puzzle comes with a limited number of moves, so you’ll need to think ahead and use them wisely. Your score also reflects how many players have successfully solved the same parking jam, giving you a sense of the challenge level. Some levels, like Level 11, are especially tricky due to the sheer number of cars blocking the way. Can you navigate through the toughest jams and free up the lot? games.title: OpenGuessr - Geo Guessing
games.description: OpenGuessr is a free trivia quiz geography game that drops you into a street-level panorama anywhere on Earth and challenges you to figure out where you are. Identify the continent, narrow it down to the country, zero in on the city, and pinpoint the exact street.
games.long_description: OpenGuessr is a free trivia quiz geography game that drops you into a street-level panorama anywhere on Earth and challenges you to figure out where you are. Identify the continent, narrow it down to the country, zero in on the city, and pinpoint the exact street. The closer you get, the more points you score. How to Play OpenGuessr - Geo Guessing You start the game off on a random road, pretty much anywhere in the world, and each round does just the same. You get placed within a street-level panorama with no hints, though you can freely navigate the virtual map, so keep your eyes peeled for road signs, language, the shape of a mountain, and the color of the soil. Explore your surroundings as much as possible, and once you have an idea of where you are based on the details, place your pin on the actual map in the bottom right-hand corner and click "Guess" to find out just how close you got. The closer your guess, the higher your score. Customize Your Geographical Location OpenGuessr will often put you in the middle of a rural area, which makes the game competitive for avid geography buffs, but a bit more difficult for your average player. Whether you're a casual explorer or a hardcore geography nerd, there's a map for you. You can customize your maps by going to Menu > Maps. Start with Capital Cities or Famous Places to get your bearings, then work up to the World map, a competitive standard that pulls from remote, rural, and obscure locations all over the globe. If that's still not enough of a challenge, individual country maps will test just how well you really know a place. And if you want to gain a bit more confidence, start with your own city if it's within the options. There is an enormous library of custom maps, over 5,000 to be more precise, made by real players. So you are not limited to the default ones you start with. Some popular Spotlight picks include: Equalized World Racetracks Airports Abandoned Places Train Stations National Parks Bridges Indoor From the Community library, players have created maps like: Football Stadiums European Cities European Capitals US Cities F1 Tracks TV & Film Locations New York City IKEA Master New maps are added constantly, and you can create your own with the built-in map creator. Game Modes OpenGuessr allows you to take on 1v1 Duels, jump into multiplayer competitions, or try special modes like Country Guesser and Image Guesser for a different kind of challenge. You can also spice things up with unique restrictions like grayscale view or no movement, which force you to rely on subtler clues than usual. These can be quite challenging. Test your skills on competitive leaderboards, challenge friends in private games, and earn badges and pins for reaching in-game achievements. Play with Friends OpenGuessr is a multiplayer game, so you don't have to go at it alone. Send messages directly to other players through the built-in chat system, and join the active Discord community where players share strategies, map recommendations, and the occasional humbling screenshot. More Games Like This If you like OpenGuessr, you may like some of our other games from our trivia collection . Try Google Feud , where you try to guess the missing parts of a Google query. Some more challenging games can be found in our puzzle collection , with games like 2048 , Hangman , Sudoku Online , Mahjong Online , and plenty more.

controls.Controls: WASD / arrow keys / drag left-click = move camera view Left-click = select map + and - = zoom in or out

games.title: Word Search
games.description: Word Search is a digital puzzle game, a version of the classic newspaper word puzzle where you find words up, down, forward, backward, and on the diagonal. If you liked newspaper puzzles, then you will love this simple but classic game.
games.long_description: Word Search is a digital puzzle game, a version of the classic newspaper word puzzle where you find words up, down, forward, backward, and on the diagonal. If you liked newspaper puzzles, then you will love this simple but classic game. How to Play Word Search You start the game by choosing your language. The game can be played in six languages: English, German, Italian, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. Try one or more if you want to practice your language skills. There are also multiple themes you can choose from: fruits, computers, countries, vegetables, music, and animals. Choose one and get ready to find hidden words. Once you’ve chosen your language and themes, you will see a grid of letters and a list of hidden words to locate. The objective is to highlight all the listed words as quickly as possible by relying on observational skills, but don’t worry too much; the list of words you’re meant to find is listed above the scrambled letter grid. Words can be hidden in straight lines horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, and the interesting part is that they can be in any direction, including backwards. The challenge lies in spotting them with a ticking timer breathing down your neck. How to Lock in Your Word Desktop: Click and drag the left mouse button across the letters of a word to highlight it. Mobile: Swipe your finger across the word. Once selected, the game usually auto-confirms a correct word by crossing it off the list or changing its color in the grid. Tip: Make sure you cover the entire last letter. Half a letter the wrong way will result as a wrong spelling. Simple Gameplay Word Search stays true to its puzzle roots, ideal for puzzle purists. There are no hints, no boosts, and no special abilities. It’s just you, a grid, the word list, and your skill. The only pressure you will meet will come from the clock. Each round will have you wanting to beat your personal best. There is no time limit to your game, though there is a timer. The time tracks how long it takes you to finish a game, but there is no limit to how much time you can spend on a game. The measure of success is time, but you decide what that success looks like. The reward is the satisfaction of solving puzzles and improving your times. There are no progressive levels, and each level is a new grid which can be easier or harder than the last, depending on your search skills and the vocabulary theme chosen. Fruits may seem easier than animals to some, but easier to others. There is no intrinsically set difficulty level. Word Search offers a simple, timeless format with endless grids, no progression pressure, and pure observational challenge. It’s a perfect game for a casual coffee-break game that you have five minutes to play, or for a Sunday at the park game where you have idle hours to play. Tips Scan methodically. Rather than darting your eyes around the puzzle randomly, use a systematic approach. A tried and true technique is to scan row by row for the first letter of each word on your list. Once you spot that letter, check in every direction around it (forwards, backwards, vertically, and diagonally) to see if it connects into the word you need. Look for unique letters. Some words are easier to find because they contain distinct letters. Looks for a Q, X, or Z, or special letter combinations such as double letters like “ee” in lychee. These tend to stand out visually in a sea of more common letters. By identifying the unique “anchors” in a word, you can track them down faster in the grid and often complete the word in seconds. Look up, down, and all around. When you are stuck on a word, make sure to check backwards and diagonals as well. If you’re looking for the word “banana”, you should also be looking for the word “a-n-a-n-a-b”, banana in reverse. Release Date December 2017 Developer Word Search was made by Code This Lab. Features A fun word-searching game Six language options Six categories Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

games.title: Tile Guru
games.description: Tile Guru is a casual puzzle tile-matching game that combines mental sharpness with relaxation. Spend just 10 minutes a day matching vibrant 3D tiles and finding new fruit designs while mastering strategic match flips.
games.long_description: Tile Guru is a casual puzzle tile-matching game that combines mental sharpness with relaxation. Spend just 10 minutes a day matching vibrant 3D tiles and finding new fruit designs while mastering strategic match flips. With its unique puzzlescapes, escalating challenges, and a serene zen-inspired color palette, this game offers a perfect blend of brain training and tranquility, making it your ideal daily escape. How to Play Tile Guru Tile Guru is one of those addictive games that you find yourself playing for hours, day after day. The aim of the game is fairly simple - you need to match sets of three tiles of the same suit. You'll start with a colorful array of fruit-themed tiles—grapes, watermelon, apples, cherries, and more. Click on each tile, and it will fall into the tile holder section. Once you get three matching tiles in the tile holder, they will disappear to make room for more. Early levels keep things simple, as all tiles are the same, making it easy to match a set of three. As the levels continue, the challenges get harder. Your tile holder is where the magic happens, and it is the part that requires the most strategy. The tile holder holds up to 7 tiles—if the holder fills up with unmatched tiles, the game is over! You will need to make sure you get as many similar tiles as possible, so be careful what you click on. As you progress, the challenge ramps up. Tiles become layered, so you’ll need to think strategically about which ones to free up first. If you grab too many unmatched tiles, you might run out of space before completing your sets. Plan ahead, keep an eye on your available space, and aim for those perfect matches to clear the board! More Games Like This Continue the fun with even more casual games . Some of our more popular titles include Little Alchemy , where you merge basic elements to create new and much more powerful ones; and Happy Wheels , a wild ragdoll physics game where your goal is to survive each level without losing your limbs. Slice Master is a one-person game whose goal is to slice everything in sight, well, almost everything. Release Date January 2024 Platform Web browser (desktop and mobile)

controls.Controls: Use the left mouse button to select the tiles, use a hint, and use power up.

games.title: Happy Wheels
games.description: Happy Wheels is a side-scrolling ragdoll physics game. Navigate through the levels using one of several unique characters without being torn limb from limb.
games.long_description: Happy Wheels is a side-scrolling ragdoll physics game. Navigate through the levels using one of several unique characters without being torn limb from limb. Sound easy? Think again. Happy Wheels was one of the earliest browser games to utilize wacky ragdoll physics as a key element of the game. How to Play Happy Wheels Happy Wheels emerged in 2010, taking the browser gaming world by storm with its wild mechanics, bizarre characters, and elaborate user-created levels. Still available in its original form today, you can explore the ingenious levels created by players and try out various characters in the game. Levels You can play through various original and user-created levels in Happy Wheels. There are countless selections to choose from, some of which are easier to play through with certain characters. Depending on the level, you could find yourself riding your wheelchair through someone's stomach or plowing through a forest on an angry cat. The goal of each level varies, from reaching the end to collecting all the tokens. Some levels are entirely aimless. You can also design your own tracks and share them with the rest of the world for testing. Happy Wheels Characters The Original 4 The characters in Happy Wheels are far from conventional in a platformer. Instead of having superpowers, you're pretty much a regular guy. The first character is Wheelchair Guy, a slightly ragged-looking older man in a jet-powered wheelchair. As you can imagine, a jet-powered wheelchair is pretty tough to control without causing severe injury. Segway Guy, on the other hand, is a bit more manageable and a common choice among seasoned Happy Wheels gamers. The other two original game characters are Irresponsible Dad (who rather irresponsibly has his kid on the back seat) and Effective Shopper, who rides a mobility scooter. Each character in Happy Wheels has an ability unique to them. Segway Guy can jump, and Wheelchair Guy can turbo-boost his jet thrusters to move faster. Learn more about the Happy Wheels character abilities . Newer Characters As Happy Wheels continued to provide endless gory entertainment for the gaming world, several new characters were released. These include the creatively named Moped Couple, Lawnmower Man, Explorer Guy, Santa Claus, Pogo Stick Man, Irresponsible Mom, and Helicopter Man. More Games Like This Is there even a game quite like Happy Wheels? Well, since the game's inception, there have been plenty of games with whacky ragdoll physics and intricate mechanics. If you're looking for a regular platformer without wild physics, check out OvO . For something a bit different but just as popular, have a go at Smash Karts, an exciting 3D kart battle game, while Shell Shockers brings intense egg-themed first-person shooter action. For a unique spin, Diep.io combines basic graphics where you protect your circle tank from other shapes. Explore our casual games for even more! The designer of the game is Jim Bonacci.

games.title: Bloons Tower Defense
games.description: Bloons Tower Defense is a casual game where your mission is to build and fortify your defenses to stop an ever-growing wave of colorful balloons from reaching the end of the track. This classic game started the legendary Bloons TD series and continues some of the gameplay.
games.long_description: Bloons Tower Defense is a casual game where your mission is to build and fortify your defenses to stop an ever-growing wave of colorful balloons from reaching the end of the track. This classic game started the legendary Bloons TD series and continues some of the gameplay. You must strategically place a wide variety of units, from dart-throwing monkeys to powerful turrets, and enhance them with upgrades to maximize your popping power. As the levels progress, so do the challenges. "Bloons Tower Defence is a game that we enjoy taking turns to play or working together to decide which towers to upgrade. There are more advanced versions you can play, but this is a great place to start. As a parent, I appreciate how it teaches my kids how to prioritize limited resources, work out the ideal sequence, and, of course, stay calm under pressure. For such a simple game, it offers a disproportionate amount of fun." Review by FamilyGamingDatabase . How to Play Bloons Tower Defense Stack your towers Find a good place to put your first defenses and start the first wave. You can only afford the dart and tack towers at this stage. The stats for each weapon are written on the right side and provide helpful information on how the towers work. Placing your defenses in areas that cover the pathways from multiple angles is best, especially where the tack tower is concerned. Buy upgrades As the levels progress, you’ll need to upgrade your existing towers to ensure you can hold back the increasing waves of balloons. Your strongest piece throughout the game will be the dart tower. These can stack anywhere and are very powerful with the piercing darts upgrade, so don’t hold back from stacking these potent monkeys together. Expand to new defenses Other balloon types that move faster, contain multiple balloons inside them, and require greater firepower are added into the mix on later levels. The trickiest of all is the black balloon. At this stage, it’s necessary to consider the bomb and ice tower, which you should be able to afford at this point. Get the super monkey You should first buy the bomb tower before buying the ice tower, as only bombs can pop frozen balloons. Things can get out of hand quickly as you get into the later game. You must think faster and build more proactively to ensure the balloons don’t break through your defenses. Eventually, you’ll be able to afford the super monkey, which shreds balloons like a machine. Complete the game Bloons Tower Defense doesn’t last forever. Once you’ve got all your defenses in the right place, you can coast through until level 50. This is the final round, and completing it ends the game. Congratulations! Now it’s time to play Bloons Tower Defense 2. More Games Like This Bloons TD 1 is a classic bit of nostalgia from the Flash games era. If you’re craving some more memories, check out the full collection. They hold up surprisingly well. World’s Hardest Game is a challenging choice, as is the legendary Papa’s Pizzeria . For other casual games , try some popular classic titles like Bubble Shooter , Frogger , and more. Developer Ninja Kiwi developed this game. Platform Web browser

controls.Controls: Click/tap the towers you'd like to build and click/tap on the area you want to put them. You can also click/tap the towers you've built to check any upgrades you can buy.

games.title: Bullet Force
games.description: Bullet Force is an online multiplayer FPS game featuring fast-paced action. Battle against other players on tactical maps using a range of weapons at your disposal.
games.long_description: Bullet Force is an online multiplayer FPS game featuring fast-paced action. Battle against other players on tactical maps using a range of weapons at your disposal. Create custom games and buy new perks to improve your character. How to Play Basic gameplay Hop into online FPS battles and put your reactions and aim skills to the test on a range of intense battleground maps from small to large. You can play live against up to 20 players using a plethora of weapons like the M4A1, Colt 45, M67 grenades, AWP sniper rifle, and many more. Game modes You’ll find all the classic FPS game modes on Bullet Force. You can play TDM (Team Death Match), FFA (Free-For-All), Conquest, and Gun Game. All of these game modes feature live-action battles between you and other players. However, you can also play offline against bots! If you just want to play quickly, you can jump into a game instantly with quick play. Customize your soldier There are over 100 camouflages and a vast array of optics, laser sights, and other weapon attachments to make your weapons your own. Along with weapons skins is full character customization, ranging from aesthetic changes to performance-boosting perks and killstreaks. You can equip these in-game to get an edge over the competition. Create a custom game You can set up your own public or private game in Bullet Force. The custom options are extensive. You can choose the game mode, max players, ping, and the specific weapons players can and can’t use. More Games Like This Bullet Force is an excellent FPS game with classic charm. If you love this kind of raw skill-based shooting game, check out Kirka.io for more. You can also check out another Blayze FPS game Forward Assault . Features Fight intense FPS gun battles with other players Play online with up to 20 people Buy new killstreaks and perks Extensive custom game options Developer Bullet Force Multiplayer is developed by Blayze Games (Lucas Wilde). Release Date The initial release date was June 2016. Since then there have been many updates to the game. Platforms Bullet Force is available as a PC game in the browser on CrazyGames (using WebGL), as an Android app, and as an iOS app. This means that you can play it on pretty much any device!

games.title: Open House
games.description: Open House is a puzzle match-3 game where you're unexpectedly tasked with turning an abandoned residence into your dream home via one puzzle at a time. Each puzzle brings about new furnishings and upgrades to keep you hooked.
games.long_description: Open House is a puzzle match-3 game where you're unexpectedly tasked with turning an abandoned residence into your dream home via one puzzle at a time. Each puzzle brings about new furnishings and upgrades to keep you hooked. You have options, so redesign rooms with your style choices, swap out furniture, and watch your estate transform from rags to riches. How to Play Open House You, Oscar, are fresh off a rough flight, and things couldn’t have started worse. Somewhere during the trip, all your belongings fell out of the plane. You beg Theo, the pilot who took you to this island, to turn back so you can find them, but he refuses, saying he has too many passengers. He takes off without you. Trying to stay positive, you decide this might be the perfect chance to start over in your new beachside home. After all, it’s only a suitcase… and luckily, you were wearing your favorite shirt during the flight. Time to see your new place. You greet your neighbor, who’s not exactly welcoming, then head toward your new home only to find it looks nothing like the pictures from the real estate listing. The porch is falling apart, the rooms are wrecked, and it’s clear today is not your day. You can’t help but wonder if you’re on some sort of prank show. Your first quest is to remove all the covers from the furniture in hopes of finding a hidden camera. To do this, you’ll complete match-3 puzzles that appear on the screen. Each match earns points and helps you move forward. As you work, you notice the place is so bad that it even has critters running around. It’s time to contact the real estate agency. You're sitting at your computer when the desk collapses. You’ll need to replace both the desk and the chair before you can write to Mr. Fraudley, the man who sold you this disaster of a house. You send him a message explaining the mess, and he blocks you immediately. Just when you’re feeling hopeless, your neighbor Charles surprises you by finding your missing suitcases, but the purple flower, which means a lot to you, is still missing. He advises you to get a wardrobe to store your clothes. After that, you’ll need a good night’s rest, which means buying a new bed. Between each home repair or furniture purchase, you’ll play match-3 puzzles to earn what you need. Every successful round brings you closer to fixing up the house. You keep trying to leave the island, but something always stops you. In the meantime, you keep decorating, cleaning, and repairing. Over time, you might just discover that this wrecked beach house has the potential to become the dream home you never knew you wanted. More Games Like This If you like Open House, browse our match-3 games for more fun. There is also plenty of variation in our puzzle category, with games like Word Search and 2048.

games.title: AOD - Art Of Defense
games.description: AOD - Art of Defence is a casual tower defense game set in a post-apocalyptic world. As Commander of the A.O.D squad, you lead the charge against Mr.
games.long_description: AOD - Art of Defence is a casual tower defense game set in a post-apocalyptic world. As Commander of the A.O.D squad, you lead the charge against Mr. Ivil's ruthless thugs, determined to find the lost Inola project. With stunning isometric graphics, build your technological kingdoms and thwart the enemy's destructive ambitions. Will you save mankind or succumb to darkness? How to Play AOD - Art of Defence Your mission in AOD Art of Defense begins with an urgent message from Mr. Ivil—find the blueprints of the fabled Inola Project at all costs—even if it means reducing the city to rubble. Time is of the essence. Meanwhile, Ich Nevel warns of an imminent large-scale assault on your bases. The stakes couldn’t be higher, and it’s up to you to defend humanity’s last hope. You have one goal - to protect your base at all costs. Dynamic battles ensure that every moment is filled with action. Combining elements of Tower Defense, RPG, and tactical strategy, the game features over 500 sectors for real-time warfare, offering a variety of environments—from small villages to massive abandoned megapolises. You’ll face challenges in exciting new Tower Defense modes like escape, fog, and survival. The aim is strategically deploying siege houses, tanks, and armed trucks to stop enemy forces before they breach your defenses. With over 1,000 tower upgrades, including tanks, miniguns, and air defense systems, your arsenal is as vast as powerful. Along the way, you’ll unlock six unique heroes, each with their own abilities to level up and master. From nuclear bombs to ionic satellite strikes and ballistic barrages, a range of devastating boosters will turn the tide in your favor. Every successful defense wave rewards you with crystals, essential for upgrading your arsenal. The longer you survive, the greater the rewards, but enemies will become stronger with each attack. Hundreds of card upgrades allow you to customize your towers for maximum efficiency, keeping your strategies fresh and adaptable. Set in a near-future world devastated by nuclear wars, 70% of the population has been wiped out. The survivors face constant terror from Mr. Ivil, who has united gangs into a brutal army bent on finding the Inola Project blueprints. His forces leave no settlement untouched, robbing and killing indiscriminately. Your task is to stop them and save what remains of the planet. In this endless survival mode, your tactics and preparation are key. Build your defenses wisely, place your siege houses strategically, and upgrade your resources to keep pace with the escalating challenge. Each location demands new strategies and better equipment, pushing your tactical skills to the limit. Whether you’re battling through small villages or abandoned megapolises, the world's fate depends on you. With the power of innovative weapons, unique heroes, and an array of upgrades, you hold the key to humanity’s survival. Will you rise to the challenge? More Games Like This There are plenty of casual games where you can show off your game skills. Want to stick to defense games? Try our Bloons Tower Defense , a casual game where you defend the track from endless balloons using clever tower placement and upgrades. Another fun game is Doodle Jump , a thrilling game that has you jumping upwards to infinity, grabbing boosts, and avoiding beasts on your way up. Release Date July 2019 (Android) December 2020 (Steam) March 2024 Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android Steam

games.title: Tower Swap
games.description: Tower Swap is a clever puzzle game combining match-3 mechanics with addictive tower defense gameplay. Stop the dragons from reaching your castle by building your defenses through tactical tile-matching decisions
games.long_description: Tower Swap is a clever puzzle game combining match-3 mechanics with addictive tower defense gameplay. Stop the dragons from reaching your castle by building your defenses through tactical tile-matching decisions. How to Play Build your defenses Match 3 pieces of the same resource to upgrade them to a weapon or defense piece. When you have 3 of the same weapon or wall beside each other, you can merge them to create more powerful units. However, merging also means less coverage over the map, so sometimes you should delay the decision to merge. Protect your castle You have a limited number of swaps available before the dragons attack, so you have to use them wisely. Position your defenses so you can weather the attack! Before the boss round the game will show an arrow indicating the area where the drag will appear. Day 10 and day 20 are the first boss dragon levels, so you need to be prepared. Once you kill a boss, they release a large number of smaller dragons. Combine resources Combine 3 of these resources to build the following defenses: Stone - creates a defensive attack tower Gunpowder - builds a cannon Ice - creates an ice wall Logs - creates an attack turret Gold - forms a chest containing swaps and sometimes other items like TNT and anvils to immediately upgrade resources. All of the created defenses above can then be merged again to build an even more powerful unit. Sign up and join a clan It's worth signing up for an account in Tower Swap! It is a simple process and will allow you to build a custom avatar using extensive options, join a clan to compete, earn gold, and unlock chests with rewards. At the end of each game you'll receive gold coins that you can use to buy lives and open chests early. More Games Like This Tower Swap is a unique game that combines elements from match-3 games and tower defense games . One of the most popular tower defense games is Tower Defense Clash . As for merge games, Farm Merge Valley is hard to beat! Features Unique mix-up of game genres Create defenses by merging resources Upgrade defenses by merging defenses Protect your castle from endless waves of dragons! Sign up to join a clan and more Developer curtastic developed Tower Swap. Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS

games.title: What's The Difference?
games.description: What's The Difference? is a casual Spot the Difference game where you must find differences in two similar images.
games.long_description: What's The Difference? is a casual Spot the Difference game where you must find differences in two similar images. Can you spot them before the online players can? Enjoy this photo hunt and puzzle-solving game. Be ready to find five differences online and prove your skills! How to Play What's The Difference? Your goal in What's The Difference is to quickly identify subtle changes between two nearly identical images. Your keen eye and swift reflexes will earn you valuable rewards, like stars that unlock treasure chests brimming with prizes. As you progress, you'll have the chance to participate in daily challenges and climb the leaderboards in weekly tournaments, competing against online players from all over. If you find yourself stuck, don’t worry! You can ask for a hint to guide you to the hidden differences. However, be cautious not to click too quickly: too many incorrect guesses will result in a warning. To add to the fun, you can express your emotions using emojis, letting other players know if you're feeling frustrated or celebrating a win. With over 1,000 levels featuring bright, high-quality images of animals, nature, sweets, and more, "What's the Difference?" offers endless entertainment for all ages. The playful scenes and colorful missions make it a great game for the whole family to enjoy together. And don’t forget to update your avatar as you progress and get ready for a thrilling speed round! Are you ready to become the best at photo hunts and puzzle solving? Travel through different worlds, find the five differences online, complete your photo hunt, participate in exciting events, and earn rewards! Do you think you can be faster than other players? Then get ready to master What's The Difference? More Games Like This If you had fun playing this casual game , then you will love a few other of our popular titles from the same category. Little Alchemy allows you to mix and match elements to create new items, offering a delightful and creative puzzle experience. games.title: WorldGuessr Free GeoGuessr
games.description: Worldguessr is a casual quiz game, a free alternative to Geoguessr, perfect for testing and expanding your geography skills through immersive Street View exploration. Each round, you will find yourself dropped into random locations around the globe, with only environmental clues to guide you in pinpointing your exact whereabouts.
games.long_description: Worldguessr is a casual quiz game, a free alternative to Geoguessr, perfect for testing and expanding your geography skills through immersive Street View exploration. Each round, you will find yourself dropped into random locations around the globe, with only environmental clues to guide you in pinpointing your exact whereabouts. From cityscapes to rural roads, your surroundings become the puzzle pieces you need to analyze, turning each game into a thrilling geographical investigation. How to Play Worldguessr In Worldguessr, each game starts by placing you somewhere on Google Maps, and if you can’t immediately guess where you are, which is likely the majority of the time as you often start on obscure, long, and winding roads, you can move around to gather valuable clues. Search for nearby landmarks, coastlines, street signs, architectural styles, and other geographical features that might give away your location. Anything with a bit of language, like signs or billboards, can be especially useful, helping you narrow down your guess to a specific country or region. Worldguessr exploration goes beyond simple gameplay, offering an engaging way to enrich your geographic knowledge. Choose from hundreds of community-created maps tailored to different regions and themes, allowing you to travel from bustling metropolises to remote wildernesses. With unlimited rounds and a variety of challenges, you can play at your own pace or jump into multiplayer modes, where you’ll compete with friends or players worldwide. For those moments when you feel completely stumped, Worldguessr offers a helpful hint feature. This hint won’t give away your exact location, but it will nudge you in the right direction by identifying the general part of the world—such as the continent—where you are. From there, the challenge is yours to explore, observe, and deduce the country, city, and even the town where you’ve been dropped, relying on your own skills to make the final call. Once you make your guess, Worldguessr reveals just how close—or far—you were from the actual location, helping you refine your skills over time. This unique blend of learning and adventure makes Worldguessr perfect for geography enthusiasts, travelers at heart, or anyone who loves a good challenge. More Games Like This If you like this game, you will want to browse our casual games for even more of the same. Popular titles include Google Feud , a quiz game where you guess a portion of Google queries; and Tile Guru , a tile-matching game designed to train your brain and promote relaxation.

games.description: Space Wars Battleground is an action battle game set in a faraway galaxy where battles are fast, numerous, and to the death. The game features numerous characters that you play with and against people from around the world to dominate the competitive leaderboard and reach the heights of galactic victory with the support of your fellow fighters.
games.long_description: Space Wars Battleground is an action battle game set in a faraway galaxy where battles are fast, numerous, and to the death. The game features numerous characters that you play with and against people from around the world to dominate the competitive leaderboard and reach the heights of galactic victory with the support of your fellow fighters. How to Play Space Wars Battleground At the beginning of each match, you start with zero experience points, putting everyone on an equal footing. To gain experience, you must deal with damage and take down enemy team characters, steadily building your strength as the battle progresses. Once you've accumulated enough experience, you can spend it on purchasing new characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles, adding depth and strategy to your gameplay. After each match, you'll also earn coins as rewards for your performance. These coins can be used to unlock a variety of weapons, character skins, and upgrades, allowing you to customize and enhance your arsenal. The ultimate goal is to work with your team to eliminate 100 enemy characters first, securing victory and bragging rights in this intense, action-packed competition. How to find your enemy It's key to use the floor plan map in the top corner of the game, which shows you exactly where your opponents are hiding and, more importantly, where your allies are as well. You want to be strategic about where your support is needed and avoid shooting friendly fire. Coordinate your moves based on where you won't be ambushed, where you can help your team, and where you have the best chance to shoot your opponents. games.title: Man Runner 2048
games.description: Man Runner 2048 is a casual arcade game where your objective is to run and merge men till you reach 2048. Your goal is to get the highest score on each round, because at the end of the level, you will get a chance to shoot a giant monster.
games.long_description: Man Runner 2048 is a casual arcade game where your objective is to run and merge men till you reach 2048. Your goal is to get the highest score on each round, because at the end of the level, you will get a chance to shoot a giant monster. The higher your score, the more power you gain. How to Play Man Runner 2048 Your ultimate goal is to merge men to reach the 2048 level, achieve the highest score possible, and then fire powerful cannonballs to damage giant monsters and take control of the islands. Each course starts pretty simply. You will need to run through a course head-on, filled with obstacles, while collecting as many points as possible. The gamescape is set up like a runway, and obstacles are everywhere. They could be right in front of you, coming from below, dropping from above. Stay vigilant and keep your eye on the prize. You want to make it to the end of the course. Along the way, collect green rewards and pink diamonds for significant score boosts, but steer clear of anything red or items that split your points. At the end of the course, you will face a giant skeleton. Aim carefully to hit your target. Experiment to find its Achilles’ heel, sometimes right between the eyes, works for maximum damage to earn extra points. You may not be able to defeat it right away, but each attempt helps you rack up a higher score. Each round introduces new obstacles, including sliding floors that can help you gather more points if you move skillfully. Be careful of spikes that rise from the ground and bombs that drop from the sky, both of which can cost you the run. Between runs, you can buy accessories to customize your character. Tip Aim for the monster's center when you fire your cannonballs at the end of the round. This is one of its weakest spots. More Games Like This If you like Man Runner 20248, you will want to browse our casual category for similar fun. Some fan favorites from this category include Little Alchemy and its sequel, Little Alchemy 2 , the classic Bubble Shooter game, Geometry Dash Online , and plenty more. If you like the puzzle part of the game, 2048 is another obvious title worth a try. Release Date November 2022 (Android) August 2023 (WebGL) Developer GMR Bros. made this game. Platforms Web browser Android

games.title: Obby World: Squid Escape
games.description: Obby World: Squid Escape is a casual parkour game where you jump your way through a whirlwind of obstacles and surprising challenges. Anything is possible in the variety of games offered.
games.long_description: Obby World: Squid Escape is a casual parkour game where you jump your way through a whirlwind of obstacles and surprising challenges. Anything is possible in the variety of games offered. You will find yourself leaping across deadly gaps, racing through winding tracks on a speedy bike, and making daring escapes from high-security prisons. Each mode offers new thrills, so get ready to test your reflexes. How to Play Obby World: Squid Escape Obby World: Squid Escape throws is a mix of parkour challenges, with each game different from the last. Each game tests your timing, balance, and quick thinking. The game begins by letting you choose from a set of different obstacle-based modes, each with its own style and surprises. You’ll face multiple rounds of challenges, such as: Red Light, Green Light: The classic stop-and-go test. Run when the light is green, freeze when it’s red. Move at the wrong time, and you’re out. Carousel Round: Follow the instructions: “run into a room,” “get into groups of two or three,” or “go solo.” It sounds simple, but without a way to communicate with other players, teamwork becomes tricky and tense. Skywalk Courses: Balance across oversized objects floating in the sky—giant coffee cups, donuts, chocolate bars, and more. One misstep and you’ll tumble straight down, ending your round. Other modes keep the action fresh, from racing down twisting bike tracks to sneaking through prison breakouts. Each one pushes you to react quickly and stay sharp under pressure. The controls are simple, but the levels demand precision. One moment you’re leaping across glowing rainbow platforms, the next you’re dodging traps or trying to outsmart guards. Success depends on timing, agility, and a little creativity in how you approach obstacles. With colorful environments, unpredictable twists, and nonstop movement, Obby World: Squid Escape is built for players who want parkour challenges that keep them on their toes. Choose your mode. In Rainbow Mode, you’ll dash across glowing platforms in a lively, colorful world. Bicycle Mode shifts the challenge to two wheels, where speed, stunts, and sharp maneuvers keep the race intense. Prison Escape raises the stakes with traps to dodge, guards to evade, and clever moves needed to break free. Each mode has its own style of thrill, and requires quick reflexes and sharp timing. Between games, you can personalize your character with outfits and accessories, giving your hero a distinct look. More Games Like This If you like the wild antics of this game, you may like games like Eggy Car , where you have to navigate an egg in a car through obstacles, ensuring it doesn't crack! Other games in our casual collection worth a try include Snow Rider 3D and Sprunki .

games.title: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer
games.description: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer is a board connect game. Similar to the table game, you need to line up four chips in a row before your opponent does to win!
games.long_description: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer is a board connect game. Similar to the table game, you need to line up four chips in a row before your opponent does to win! You can play with friends, against the computer or against online players. How to Play Connect 4 Online Multiplayer The goal is simple: get four of your pieces in a row before your opponent does. Horizontal, vertical, or diagonal, they all count. Whoever connects four first takes the round. From the home screen, you pick how you want to play: Play Online to get matched with another player Play Bots to practice against the computer Create Room to set up your own game Play in Person to take on a real person instead of a bot Every game you finish earns XP and coins, and you spend those coins in the shop on cosmetics. You start small (a fresh account starts with 90 coins), and the catalog runs from cheap items like the 50-coin Teal Board all the way up to 40,000-coin characters. How to drop discs and win in Connect 4 Online Multiplayer Pick a mode from the home screen. If you hit Play Online and change your mind, click Cancel Search. For a bot game, choose Public or Private and set the Bot Difficulty. Pick your side: ghosts or pumpkins. Click the half-ghost, half-pumpkin face if you want the game to choose for you. Click Start Game. Left-click the board to drop a disc into a column (tap if you're on mobile). Watch the timer under your name. If it runs out, you lose your turn. Connect four of your pieces to win. After the game, you can share a replay, leave the room, or wait for the countdown to send you back to the lobby. Bots, Rooms, and Ways to Play When you choose to play bots, you'll face bot opponents like Bulby and Rival Hare, and you can set the difficulty before you start (Average is one of the options). Just know the difficulty level isn't constant so it will get more difficult. The room panel shows a difficulty number during the game, and it can change, so one bot match might feel easier or tougher than the last. It's still the best place to warm up before you take on a real person. If you want to play with someone specific, Create Room gives you an invite code, and your friend can get in with Join by Code. You can also click Show Rooms to see what's open right now. Rooms can be Public or Private, so you control who gets in. XP and Leveling Up Every game feeds two XP bars: one for 4 in a Row Connect itself and one for your overall account. A single win against a bot was worth +64 game XP and +12 account XP. The first game level takes 150 XP, and the first account level takes 500, so you'll level up after just a few games. Hover over the level icons at the top of the screen to see your current level and how much XP you need to reach the next one. The Shop: Coins, Gems, and Rarity You earn coins by playing games, and you spend them on items in the shop. Gems buy unique cosmetics, and the game jokes that they're scientifically proven to make you cooler. Hit the GET GEMS button at the top of the shop if you want more. Items come in Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic rarities, and some are on sale with discounts from 10% to 50% off. The shop refreshes on a countdown timer, so if you don't see something you like, check back later. Here's what's in the shop: Cursors range from the 10,000-coin Hand Cursor to the 30,000-coin Kebab and Marker Cursors, while gem cursors like the Pen Cursor cost 200 gems. Frames (like the Pirate Frame, Crab Frame, and Cat Headset Frame) dress up your profile picture. Chat Colors are the cheap entry point: Mint Whisper is 280 coins, Seafoam Breeze is 220, and Silver is 100 gems. The shop also carries items for other games, like Carrom boards and pieces, Checkers pieces, Chess boards and piece sets, Foonopoly tokens, and Foony Brawl Fighters (Tad is 4,000 coins, Shelly and Tava are 40,000 each). There's also a Marketplace button next to the shop if you want to look beyond the current lineup. Ghosts vs. Pumpkins: The Halloween Theme For a limited time, the board has a full Halloween makeover: witch hat, bubbling cauldron, broom, jack-o'-lanterns, and tombstones around the frame. Instead of plain discs, one side plays ghosts and the other plays pumpkins. Hover over your ghost and you'll see it's called the Boo Piece, marked Unsellable. The Halloween look is seasonal, so enjoy it while it lasts. The game keeps getting new content, so expect more to show up. Chat and Community Every game has a chat panel on the right where you can type to your opponent, and there's a Join our Discord button on the home screen if you want to find other players. The game gives you a random username, which keeps you anonymous from the start. Like any online game with open chat, not everybody's going to be pleasant. If someone gets weird or rude, you don't have to stick around: click Leave room and move on. For games with people you actually know, use a Private room and share the code directly.Similar games More Games Like This If you like this game you will love our puzzle category where you will find games like Word Wipe or Uno Online which ranks among our favorite multiplayer games, as well as 2048 , Block Blast and plenty more. content_guide.summary: Connect 4 Online Multiplayer is a board connect game. Similar to the table game, you need to line up four chips in a row before your opponent does to win!
content_guide.how_to: The goal is simple: get four of your pieces in a row before your opponent does. Horizontal, vertical, or diagonal, they all count. Whoever connects four first takes the round. From the home screen, you pick how you want to play: Play Online to get matched with another player Play Bots to practice against the computer Create Room to set up your own game Play in Person to take on a real person instead of a bot Every game you finish earns XP and coins, and you spend those coins in the shop on cosmetics. You start small (a fresh account starts with 90 coins), and the catalog runs from cheap items like the 50-coin Teal Board all the way up to 40,000-coin characters. How to drop discs and win in Connect 4 Online Multiplayer Pick a mode from the home screen. If you hit Play Online and change your mind, click Cancel Search. For a bot game, choose Public or Private and set the Bot Difficulty. Pick your side: ghosts or pumpkins. Click the half-ghost, half-pumpkin face if you want the game to choose for you. Click Start Game. Left-click the board to drop a disc into a column (tap if you're on mobile). Watch the timer under your name. If it runs out, you lose your turn. Connect four of your pieces to win. After the game, you can share a replay, leave the room, or wait for the countdown to send you back to the lobby. Bots, Rooms, and Ways to Play When you choose to play bots, you'll face bot opponents like Bulby and Rival Hare, and you can set the difficulty before you start (Average is one of the options). Just know the difficulty level isn't constant so it will get more difficult. The room panel shows a difficulty number during the game, and it can change, so one bot match might feel easier or tougher than the last. It's still the best place to warm up before you take on a real person. If you want to play with someone specific, Create Room gives you an invite code, and your friend can get in with Join by Code. You can also click Show Rooms to see what's open right now. Rooms can be Public or Private, so you control who gets in. XP and Leveling Up Every game feeds two XP bars: one for 4 in a Row Connect itself and one for your overall account. A single win against a bot was worth +64 game XP and +12 account XP. The first game level takes 150 XP, and the first account level takes 500, so you'll level up after just a few games. Hover over the level icons at the top of the screen to see your current level and how much XP you need to reach the next one. The Shop: Coins, Gems, and Rarity You earn coins by playing games, and you spend them on items in the shop. Gems buy unique cosmetics, and the game jokes that they're scientifically proven to make you cooler. Hit the GET GEMS button at the top of the shop if you want more. Items come in Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Epic rarities, and some are on sale with discounts from 10% to 50% off. The shop refreshes on a countdown timer, so if you don't see something you like, check back later. Here's what's in the shop: Cursors range from the 10,000-coin Hand Cursor to the 30,000-coin Kebab and Marker Cursors, while gem cursors like the Pen Cursor cost 200 gems. Frames (like the Pirate Frame, Crab Frame, and Cat Headset Frame) dress up your profile picture. Chat Colors are the cheap entry point: Mint Whisper is 280 coins, Seafoam Breeze is 220, and Silver is 100 gems. The shop also carries items for other games, like Carrom boards and pieces, Checkers pieces, Chess boards and piece sets, Foonopoly tokens, and Foony Brawl Fighters (Tad is 4,000 coins, Shelly and Tava are 40,000 each). There's also a Marketplace button next to the shop if you want to look beyond the current lineup. Ghosts vs. Pumpkins: The Halloween Theme For a limited time, the board has a full Halloween makeover: witch hat, bubbling cauldron, broom, jack-o'-lanterns, and tombstones around the frame. Instead of plain discs, one side plays ghosts and the other plays pumpkins. Hover over your ghost and you'll see it's called the Boo Piece, marked Unsellable. The Halloween look is seasonal, so enjoy it while it lasts. The game keeps getting new content, so expect more to show up. Chat and Community Every game has a chat panel on the right where you can type to your opponent, and there's a Join our Discord button on the home screen if you want to find other players. The game gives you a random username, which keeps you anonymous from the start. Like any online game with open chat, not everybody's going to be pleasant. If someone gets weird or rude, you don't have to stick around: click Leave room and move on. For games with people you actually know, use a Private room and share the code directly.Similar games

games.title: Empire City
games.description: Empire City is a casual management game where you strategically construct and govern a thriving empire from nothing. Build magnificent cities, develop resources, and create a unique culture while engaging in trade and diplomacy.
games.long_description: Empire City is a casual management game where you strategically construct and govern a thriving empire from nothing. Build magnificent cities, develop resources, and create a unique culture while engaging in trade and diplomacy. Expand your influence, make historic discoveries, and craft wonders that will be remembered for centuries. Your choices shape the future of your empire: lead wisely! How to Play Empire City Empire City is a classic management game set in ancient times where you get to build an entire city, including roadways, residential homes, waterways, workshops, and more -- all from a blank slate with a bit of help from two close advisors: Julia and Flavius. The game starts with a full intro from Julia and Flavius, which will walk you through step by step how to build your city. Once you have the hang of it, you're on your own. But not to worry, help from your advisors is just a click away. Julia and Flavius guide you through the following directions: Julia: "Welcome to the city, Prefect! I’m Julia. I run an inn here, and I know everything about everyone. This is Flavius, the architect." Flavius: "My projects can do the talking for me! The first one is a residential building. Let’s get to work!" Julia: "Remember, every building in the city must be connected to a road." Action: You get to build a road. Flavius: "Congratulations, Prefect! The building is ready. We can house people in it now." Julia: "People?! There’s barely room for one citizen. The building needs to be upgraded." Action: Build a house. Flavius: "Prefect, we have a problem. We need clay to make the house more spacious, but it’s mined outside the city." Julia: "If it’s even mined at all! The clay quarry is in bad shape, and the tool storage is totally dilapidated. But our Prefect can solve that, right?" Action: Fix the clay quarry. Julia: "Now we can hire a manager! But that can happen later. First, we need to build a road to deliver the clay to the city." Action: Build a road. Flavius: "The road is wonderful, Prefect! Collect the mined clay, and my people will deliver it to the construction site right away." Action: Collect the clay. Flavius: "Thank you for the help. I’ll get to work upgrading the house right now!" Julia: "You and Flavius are doing wonderfully! Let’s upgrade another house. It could use a second floor, with a good view of the city." Flavius: "Regular clay isn’t enough to build another floor. This requires a sturdier material, such as clay mixture." Julia: "Alas, this material isn’t produced in our city. Although the Prefect could give orders to build a special workshop." Julia: "If you don’t want to wait, use gems! Their shine speeds up any project. The first time is free, though." Action: Use gems. Flavius: "Very grand, Prefect. Now we won’t lack building materials. Give the order to produce clay mixture." Julia: "Production can take a long time. When it ends, a clay mixture icon will appear above the workshop." Action: Wait for production to finish. Flavius: "It’s ready, Prefect! Tap the icon to move the mixture to the warehouse." Action: Move the mixture to the warehouse. Julia: "So, are we going to upgrade the house or just pretend that it’s intentionally unfinished?" Flavius: "Please accept this scroll. I sketched out some improvements. Remember, Prefect, Julia and I are always here to support you!" You're on your own after this training. Continue building your empire and make Julia and Flavius proud, Prefect! More Games Like This If you are in Empire City, you may like more games within our casual game category , so go ahead and have a look! You may also like some of our clicker classics like Mr Mine , where you get to mine precious stones for rewards; Planet Clicker is another fun idle clicker game where you generate resources to expand and upgrade their planet gradually; or Clicker Heroes , which is a classic clicker game that challenges players to kill as many monsters as possible to earn coins and summon heroes! Release Date June 2022 (Android) August 2022 (iOS) August 2024 (HTML5) Platforms Web browser (desktop and mobile) Android iOS
